sa: तथा ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं तारा ताराधिपनिभानना॥
en: When Sumitra's son, Laksmana, had spoken thus, flaming in energy, Tārā of face fair as the moon, said to him,

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम्। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतः सुमहद्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing that speech of his capable of enhancing joy and manliness, Sugrīva overjoyed, spoke those words informed with high sense.

sa: विपरीते तुष्टिहीना वनवासं गते मयि। राजानं नातिशङ्केत मिथ्यावादीति धार्मिकम् ॥
en: Then well pleased on my having repaired to the woods, she will not entertain any apprehension anent the righteous monarch, thinking that he is intruthful.

sa: व्याहन्तास्यशुभाचरे यदि रामाभिषेचनम्॥ न शक्तोऽद्यास्म्यहं द्रष्टुं दृष्ट्वा पूर्वं तथामुखम्। हतहर्षं तथानन्दं पुनर्जनमवाङ्मुखम्॥
en: That countenance of Rāma which I have once seen expanded in delight, I shall never be able to behold bereft of joy and cheerfulness, and down, with melancholy clouding it

sa: वामेन सीतां पद्माक्षी मूर्धजेषु करेण सः। ऊर्वोस्तु दक्षिणेनैव परिजग्राह पाणिना॥
en: With his left hand he held her, having eyes like to lotus-petals, by the hair, and with his right hand got hold of her thighs.

sa: कौसल्यां धर्मसंयुक्तां वियुक्तां पापनिश्चये। कृत्वा कं प्राप्स्यसे ह्यद्य लोकं निरयगामिनि॥
en: O you of sinful ways, having separated the virtuous Kausalya (from her son), what world, O you that repairest to hell, shall be your portion?

sa: प्रताम्य वा प्रज्वल वा प्रणश्य वा सहस्त्रशो वा स्फुटितां महीं व्रज। मुखात् पतन्त्यधो न ते करिष्यामि वचः सुदारुणं ममाहितं केकयराजपांसने॥
en: O you that render infamous the king of the Kekayas, whether you become miserable, or enter into fire, or kill yourself by taking poison, or dive into the bowels of the earth opened at thousand places, I will not execute your fell intention that is fraught with evil to me.

sa: तस्येन्द्रकल्पस्य दुरासदस्य महानुभावस्य समीपमार्या। आर्ताऽतितूर्णं व्यसनं प्रपन्ना जगाम तारा परिविह्वलन्ती॥
en: The worshipful Tārā, worked with grief, and overwhelmed with disasters, bewailing, neared quickly that high-souled one, resembling the lord of celestials and hard to approach.

sa: कृतकृत्या महाभागा वैदेही जनकात्मजा। भर्तारं सागरान्तायाः पृथिव्या यानुगच्छति॥
en: Blessed is Vaidehī, the eminently virtuous daughter of Janaka, who follows the lord of this Earth bounded by the seas.

sa: लोकास्त्वप्रतिमा राम निर्जितास्तपसा मया। जहि ताञ्छरमुख्येन मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः॥
en: O Rāma, the regions I have conquered by my asceticism do you destroy with that foremost of arrows: let there be no delay about it.

sa: तां चारुनेत्रां कपिसिंहनाथां पतिं समाश्लिष्य तदा शयानाम्। उत्थापयामासुरदीनसत्त्वां मन्त्रिप्रधानाः कपिराजपत्नीम्।।
en: Thereupon the principal counsellors raised up the brave spouse of the lord of monkeys, having graceful eyes and lying on the earth, embracing her husband.

sa: कौसल्या मां च रामं च पुत्रौ च यदि हास्यति। दुःखान्यसहती देवी मामेवानुगमिष्यति॥
en: And if Kausalyā loses me and Rāma, and Sumitrā loses her two sons and me and Rāma, then tormented with the extreme of grief, those exalted ladies will follow me.

sa: अथ वज्री तमामन्त्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम्। रथेन हययुक्तेन ययौ दिवमरिंदमः॥
en: Then rendering homage to that anchorite and conversing with him, the wielder of the thunderbolt-subduer of enemies-repaired to heaven in a car yoked with steeds.

sa: कौसल्या सुप्रजास्तात रामस्त्वं विदितो मया। वैदेही च महाभागा लक्ष्मणश्च महायसाः॥
en: Now I know you that are Rāma, the worthy Son of Kausalyā, my child; as well as the highly virtuous Vaidehi and the renowned Lakşmaņa.

sa: यदि राज्यस्य हेतोस्त्वमिमां वाचं प्रभाषसे। वक्ष्यामि भरतं दृष्ट्वा राज्यमस्मै प्रदीयताम्॥
en: If you speak thus for the sake of the monarchy, on seeing Bharata, I will say to him, "Make over the kingdom to this one/"

sa: तेन सत्याभिसंधेन त्रिवर्गमनुतिष्ठता। पालिता सा पुरी श्रेष्ठा इन्द्रेणेवामरावती॥
en: As Indra rules Amarāvatī, that one firm in promise, and following duty, profit, and pleasure, ruled that best of cities.

sa: यदि सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतत् तदसत्यं भविष्यति। किं मां वक्ष्यति कौसल्या राघवे वनमास्थिते॥ किं चैनां प्रतिवक्ष्यामि कृत्वा विप्रियमीदृशम्।
en: Even if I speak this truly, yet none will lend credence to it. And what will Kausalya say to me, when Rāma shall have gone to the forest? Having done her this mighty wrong, what shall I say to her?

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः। प्रत्युवाच महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः॥
en: Hearing this speech addressed by Raghu's descendant that one versed in speech, the highly energetic and mighty saint, Viśvāmitra, answered.

sa: स्रोतोभ्यो बहु रक्तं तु तस्य सुस्राव पात्यतः। पपात च महाबाहुः क्षितौ पञ्चत्वमागतः॥
en: There was a profusion of blood falling from the ears of that one crushed down. Thereupon that one of mighty arms fell down to the earth and breathed his last.

sa: नात्यासादयितव्यास्ते वानरैर्भीमविक्रमैः। नादेयं च फलं तस्माद्देशात् किंचित् प्लवङ्गमैः॥
en: The monkeys of dreadful prowess should not present themselves before those, nor should they take any fruits from that country.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा पतितांस्तत्र मुनिः शोणितविपुषः। क्रुद्धस्तस्य महाभाग चिन्तयामास को न्वयम्।॥
en: O great one, beholding the drops of blood there, the great ascetic, angered, thought within himself-Who might be the author of this sprinkling of blood?

sa: सत्वेन लोकाञ्जयति द्विजान् दानेन राघवः। गुरुञ्छुश्रूषया वीरो धनुषा युधि शात्रवान्॥
en: He conquers all the twice-born ones by gifts; and that hero conquers his superiors by ministrations; and his enemies by encountering them with the bow.

sa: इह तेनाप्रवेष्टव्यं प्रविष्टस्य वधो भवेत्। वनं मत्संश्रयं येन दूषितं रुधिरस्रवैः॥
en: He shall not enter here who has spoiled the sanctity of my forest with showers of blood. And surely he shall be killed (on entering).

sa: कदा प्रेक्ष्य नरव्याघ्रावरण्यात् पुनरागतौ। भविष्यति पुरी हृष्टा समुद्र इव पर्वणि॥
en: When, seeing those foremost of men returned from the forest, will the city overflow with delight, like the ocean on the occasion of a Parva?

sa: अग्निहेत्रे च ऋषिणा हुते च विधिपूर्वकम्। कपोताङ्गारुणो धूमो दृश्यते पवनोद्धतः॥
en: The smoke arising from the fire-sacrifice duly performed by the ascetics, reddish like the hue of the pigeon's neck, is seen, wafted by the wind.

sa: कामं राघव ते वाणी प्रमाणं धैर्यमाकृतिः। सूचयन्ति परं तेजो भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्॥
en: O Rāghava, your words, patience and figure are the proofs of your heroism—truly do they bespeak of your valour like to fire hidden by ashes.

sa: मिदं कुलं राघव मनिमित्तम्। दर्धस्थितप्राणमितीव मन्ये॥
en: Methinks, for me, O Rāghava, these mighty monkeys and Angada are almost half-dead (with grief).

sa: न चेयं तव काकुत्स्थ व्रीडा भवितुमर्हति। त्वया त्रैलोक्यनाथेन यदहं विमुखीकृतः॥
en: And, O Kākutstha, neither ought I to be ashamed (because of this discomfiture); I have been baffled by the lord himself of the three worlds.

sa: महायज्ञे तदा तस्य वरुणेन महात्मना। दत्तं धनुर्वरं प्रीत्या तूणी चाक्षय्यसायकौ॥
en: In the great sacrifice of Daksa, the highsouled Varuna had well-pleased conferred on Devarata an excellent bow with inexhaustible arrows and a couple of quivers.

sa: तस्य जाम्बूनदैः शृङ्गः पर्वतस्य समुत्थितैः। आकाशं शस्त्रसंकाशमभवत् काञ्चनप्रभम्॥ जातरूपमयैः शृङ्गैः भ्राजमानैर्महाप्रभैः। आदित्यशतसंकाशः सोऽभवद् गिरिसत्तमः॥
en: To golden summits of that mountain being thus lifted up, the dark-blue sky assumed the golden hue. And by those highly resplendent golden peaks that best of mountains assumed the brilliance of a thousand suns.

sa: एक एव रणे वाली शरेण निहतो मया। त्वां तु सत्यादतिक्रान्तं हनिष्यामि सबान्धवम्॥
en: I killed Vāli only with my shaft in the battlefield; but if you did deviate from the path of truth I shall destroy you along with your kinsmen and relatives.

sa: कृतदाराः कृतास्त्राश्च सधनाः ससुहृज्जनाः॥ शुश्रूषमाणाः पितरं वर्तयन्ति नरर्षभाः।
en: And having attained brides, and arms, with wealth and friends, those foremost of men, engaged in ministering to their father.

sa: कदाचित् तु महातेजा योजयित्वा वरूथिनीम्। अक्षौहिणीपरिवृतः परिचक्राम मेदिनीम्॥
en: And it came to pass that once with his four fold forces marshalled, he set out for ranging the earth.

sa: दर्शनं शरभङ्गस्य सुतीक्ष्णेन समागमम्। अनसूयासमाख्यां च अङ्गरागस्य चार्पणम्॥
en: And Rāma's interview with Sarabhanga and meeting with Sutiksna; and Sita's companionship with Anasūyā, and the latter's painting the former.

sa: तमहं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा सूर्यरश्मिभिरतिम्। पक्षाभ्यां छादयामास स्नेहात् परमविह्वलम्॥
en: Witnessing my brother severely struck by the solar rays and exceedingly stupefied, I from affection shadowed him with my wings.

sa: अहं पुत्रसहाया त्वामुपासे गतचेतनम्। सिंहेन पातितं सद्यो गौः सवत्सेव गोवृषम्॥
en: I am with my son, standing by you who are dead, like to a cow with her calf, having the bull slain by a lion.

sa: एवमुक्ता वसिष्ठेन शबला शत्रुसूदन। विदधे कामधुक् कामान् यस्य यस्येप्सितं यथा॥
en: Thus addressed by Vasiştha, that bestower of all that was desired, Sabala, O destroyer of your foes, brought forth everything that was desired by everyone.

sa: नहि तस्य पुरा देवी तां वेलामत्यवर्तत ॥ न च राजा गृहं शून्यं प्रविवेश कदाचन। ततो गृहगतो राजा कैकेयी पर्यपृच्छत ॥ यथापुरमविज्ञाय स्वार्थलिप्सुमपण्डिताम्।
en: Never before this that noble lady spent that hour (at any other place); nor had the monarch ever entered the empty apartment. Then the king entering the apartment asked (a sentinel) concerning Kaikeyi, not knowing that that unwise woman was hankering after her selfinterest, as on previous occasions not finding her he used to ask.

sa: अस्माकमपि सम्बन्धः कपिमुख्य त्वयास्ति वै। प्रख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु महागुणपरिग्रहः॥
en: O leader of monkeys, my relation with you is replete with many virtues and known all over the three worlds.

sa: ततः प्रभातसमये दिवसेऽथ चतुर्दशे। समेत्य राजकर्तारो भरतं वाक्यमब्रुवन्॥
en: Then on the morning of the fourteenth day, the ministers of the king assembled addressed Bharata in the following words.

sa: सा तु ताराधिपमुखी रावणेन निरीक्ष्य तम्। गृध्रराजं विनिहतं विललाप सुदुःखिता॥
en: Beholding the king of vultures slain by Rāvana, that one possessed of a face fair as the moon, stricken with grief, broke out into lamentations.

sa: इत्युक्तवन्तं रामस्तं राजपुत्रस्तपस्विनम्। न शशाकोत्तरैर्वाक्यैरवबद्धं समुत्सुकम्॥
en: When the anxious ascetic had said this, Rāma could not console him by his words.

sa: ज्येष्ठस्य राजता नित्यमुचिता हि कुलस्य नः। नैवं भवन्तो मां वक्तुमर्हन्ति कुशला जनाः॥
en: In our line it is ever fit for the first-born alone to perform the task of government. It does not behove you who are wise to say so to me.

sa: न नूनं राम जानासि महद्व्यसनमात्मनः। धावन्ति नूनं काकुत्स्थ मदर्थं मृगपक्षिणः॥
en: And, O Rāma, although birds and beasts are scampering away before you on my account, you under-stand not the mighty mishap that has befallen you.

sa: तेषामौत्सुक्यमालक्ष्य रामस्त्वात्मनि शङ्कितः। कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमृषि कुलपतिं ततः॥
en: Perceiving their anxiety, Rāma apprehensive of himself, with joined hands addressed the patriarchal ascetic, saying.

sa: रामस्य चरितं कृत्स्नं कुरु त्वमृषिसत्तम। धर्मात्मनो भगवतो लोके रामस्य धीमतः॥ वृत्तं कथय धीरस्य यथा ते नारदाच्छुतम्।
en: Do you now, O best of saints, compose the entire history of Rāma. Do you relate to the world the history of the righteous-souled and intelligent Rāma crowned with qualities. And do you, as you have heard it from Närada.

sa: वसन्ति हि महात्मानस्तत्र सूर्यसमप्रभाः। देवैरभ्यर्थिताः सम्यग् देवरूपा महर्षयः॥
en: There dwell certain Maharsis, high-souled, of effulgence resembling that of the sun-complete god-like shapes,—who are sought by the deities themselves.

sa: तदा हेमोपमा तत्र कुब्जावाक्यवशंगता। संविश्य भूमौ कैकेयी मन्थरामिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then sitting down upon the ground, Kaikeyi, comparable to gold, under the influence of Manthara's words, spoke to her, saying.

sa: नियुक्ष्व मां महातेजस्त्वं ब्रह्मबलसम्भृताम्। तस्य दर्प बलं यत्नं नाशयामि दुरात्मनः॥
en: O highly energetic one, do you command me bursting with Brahmā forces: the pride, power and endeavours of that wicked one will I bring down.

sa: त्वं पद्ममिव वातेन संनता प्रियदर्शना। उरस्तेऽभिनिविष्टं वै यावत् स्कन्धात् समुन्नतम्॥
en: But you alone down, look beautiful like a lotus bent by the breeze. Your breast weighed down by your hump, is high near the shoulders.

sa: किमर्थं तप्यसे राजन् ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्। वरदोऽस्मि वरो यस्ते काङ्क्षितः सोऽभिधीयताम्।।१४।
en: What for, O king, art you performing penance?. Do you unfold what you have to say. I am for conferring a boon: do you express what boon you would obtain.

sa: तैस्तन्निषूदितं सर्वं विश्वामित्रस्य तत्क्षणात्। सपदातिगजं साश्वं सरथं रघुनन्दन॥
en: And, (descendant of Raghu, Viśvāmitra's entire host consisting of foot, and elephant, and horse, and car, was exterminated by them.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। समीपस्थमुवाचेदं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम्॥
en: Having said this, the virtuous Bharata attached to his brother spoke to Sumantra skilled in counsel, who was by, saying.

sa: एवमुक्तः सुमन्त्रस्तु भरतेन महात्मना। प्रहृष्टः सोऽदिशत् सर्वं यथासंदिष्टमिष्टवत्॥
en: Thus accosted by the magnanimous Bharata, Sumantra with a cheerful heart issued orders concerning everything desirable as he was ordered.

sa: वैदेह्याः प्रियकामेन कृतं कर्म जटायुषा। गृध्रराजेन यत् तत्र श्रुतं वस्तदशेषतः॥
en: You have in detail heard all that, inspired with the desire of doing what is good to Vaidehi, that king of vultures, Jatayu, did here.

sa: क्रोधागारं प्रविश्याद्य क्रुद्धेवाश्वपतेः सुते। शेष्वानन्तर्हितायां त्वं भूमौ मलिनवासिनी॥
en: Entering the anger-chamber to-day, do you, O daughter of Aśvapati, clad in soiled garment, lie down on the uncovered floor.

sa: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि रामे प्रव्राजिते वनम्। प्रजाभावगतस्नेहः स्थिरः पुत्रो भविष्यति॥
en: On Rāma having been banished into the woods for fourteen years, your son securing the affections of subjects, will be firmly established (on the throne).

sa: अहोऽस्मि व्यसने मग्नः सर्वथा रिपुनाशन। किं त्विदानीं करिष्यामि शङ्के प्राप्तव्यमीदृशम्॥
en: Alas! absolutely sunk am I in peril, O destroyer of foes. What shall I do now? I fear such an event was appointed for me.

sa: त्वरते कार्यकाले मे अहश्चाप्यतिवर्तते। प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता न स्थातव्यमिहान्तरा॥
en: Business wants me to go soon and the time is well-nigh spent. Besides I have promised that I shall not halt at any intermediate place.

sa: आगता हि महावीर्या हरयः कामरूपिणः। कोटी: शतसहस्राणि नानाजगनिवासिनः॥
en: And monkeys by hundreds and thousands and koțis, inhabiting various mountains, possessed of exceeding prowess, have already arrived (here). to

sa: तदेतत् प्रसमीक्ष्याहं प्रसन्नेन्द्रियमानसः। तपो महत् समास्थास्ये यद्वै ब्रह्मत्वकारणम्॥
en: Beholding this, I with a placid mind and senses will engage in mighty austerities, which shall earn for me Brāhmaṇa-hood.

sa: देवेनोपहतो राजन्यो भवेदिह पूरुषः। स दैवमेवाश्रयते नान्यत्तत्र परायणम्॥
en: O King, he who is afflicted by Fate, has his recourse to Fate alone. Nothing else can be his refuge.

sa: तां भुजाभ्यां परिष्वज्य श्वश्रूर्वचनमब्रवीत्। अनाचरन्तीं कृपणं मू[पाघ्राय मैथिलीम्।१९।।
en: Then embracing with her arms Mithila's daughter of noble behaviour, and smelling the crown of her head, Sītā's mother-in-law said.

sa: निवृत्तोऽहमनुज्ञातो रामेण सुमहात्मना। अयोध्यामेव गच्छामि गृहीत्वा पादुके शुभे॥
en: Commanded by the magnanimous Rāma, I retrace my steps. I will go to Ayodhyā, taking the sandals along with me.

sa: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः॥ अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्। जिता राजर्षिलोकास्ते तपसा कुशिकात्मज ॥ अनेन तपसा त्वां हि राजर्षिरिति विद्महे।
en: And when a thousand years had been completed, the Grand-sire of all, Brahma, addressed the ascetic, Viśvāmitra in sweet words, saying, 'O son of Kusika, the regions of the Rājarșis have been won by you through your austerities. And account of this your asceticism, we recognise you as a Rājarși.'

sa: अथोर्ध्वं दूरमागत्य हित्वा शैलमहार्णवौ। पितुः पन्थानमासाद्य जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे॥
en: Leaving the mountain and the ocean and rising his up, he proceeded in the clear welkin traversing the aerial way.

sa: इदं तावद् यथाकाममीश्वरस्य कृते कृतम्। रामस्य तु परित्यागे न हेतुमुपलक्षये॥
en: Even if this has been done in harmony with the wish of the Lord, I do not perceive any reason for the banishment of Rāma.

sa: न मद्विधो दुष्कृतकर्मकारी मन्ये द्वितीयोऽस्ति वसुंधरायाम्। शोकानुशोको हि परम्पराया मामेति भिन्दन् हृदयं मनश्च ॥
en: Methinks there is none other on this earth like me, the perpetrator of vicious crimes. My heart or soul is not riven though crushed again and again without respite with a multitude of doleful events.

sa: क्व गतो लप्स्यसे शर्म मम भर्तुर्महात्मनः। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण बिना भ्रातरमाहवे॥ राक्षसा निहता येन सहस्राणि चतुर्दश। कथं स राघवो वीरः सर्वास्त्रकुशलो बली॥
en: Having done this foul turn to that high-souled one, repairing whither, shall you obtain respite? Shall not that strong and heroic Rāghava, skilled in all weapons, who without his brother, in the twinkling of an eye, in battle slew fourteen thousand Rākṣasas, slay you, who carries away his beloved wife?

sa: किं धावसि प्रिये नूनं दृष्टासि कमलेक्षणे। वृक्षराच्छाद्य चात्मानं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे॥
en: O dear! O you having eyes like to lotuses! why do you fly away? Surely have I seen you. Why do you not address me hiding yourself behind the tree?

sa: अनुरूपाणि कर्माणि विक्रम्य बलवान् रणे। करिष्यत्येष तारेयस्तेजस्वी तरुणोऽङ्गदः॥
en: This youthful Angada, Tārā's son, gifted with energy and strength, shall perform befitting exploits displaying his prowess in the battle.

sa: ततः कोपसमाविष्टो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः। स्रुवमुद्यम्य सक्रोधस्त्रिशङ्कुमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon, getting into a wrath, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, lifting up a garland, wrathfully exclaimed.

sa: महाराजकुलीनेन महाभागेन धीमता। जातो दशरथेनोया न रामः स्वप्तुमर्हति॥
en: Begot of that foremost of monarchs, the exalted and intelligent Daſaratha, Rāma does not deserve to sleep on the earth.

sa: तं ते भयपरीताङ्गाः क्षुब्धं दृष्ट्वा प्लवङ्गमाः। कालमृत्युयुगान्ताभं शतशो विद्वता दिशः॥
en: Beholding Lakṣmaṇa, highly enraged, terrible as Death himself at the time of dissolution, the monkeys, stricken with fear, fled away, by hundreds, into various quarters.

sa: वयं वनचरा राम मृगा मूलफलाशिनः। एषा प्रकृतिरस्माकं पुरुषस्त्वं नरेश्वर ॥
en: We are, O Rama, wild beasts ranging in the forest and living on roots and fruits-our nature is such—but you are a man, O king.

sa: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यानि वने त्वया। तान्युपक्रमितव्यानि यानि देव्या प्रचोदितः॥
en: You will have to spend fourteen years in the forest, and your stay must commence from this very day. So the noble lady has ordered.

sa: व्युष्य रात्रिं तु तत्रैव गङ्गाकूले स राघवः। काल्यमुत्थाय शत्रुघ्नमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having spent the night there on the banks of the Gangā, that descendant of Raghu rising early in the morning, said these words to Satrughna.

sa: न तेऽस्त्यपचितिधर्मे नार्थे बुद्धिरवस्थिता। इन्द्रियैः कामवृत्तः सन् कृष्यसे मनुजेश्वर ॥
en: You have no attachment for virtue, no comprehension of right things and are always guided by your passions albeit you are a lord of men.

sa: आकाशप्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्ययः। तस्मान्मरीचिः संजज्ञे मरीचेः कश्यपः सुतः॥
en: Brahma eternal, existing through all time and incapable of decay, sprang from the sky. From him Marici came into being, and Kaśyapa is Marici's son.

sa: तद् वाक्यमृषिपुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा हर्षसमन्वितः जगाम नृपतिः शीघ्रं यज्ञवाटमतन्द्रितः॥
en: Hearing those words of the ascetic's son, the king, filled with delight, readily at once repaired to the sacrificial ground.

sa: एवमुक्ता हनुमता तापसी धर्मचारिणी॥ प्रत्युवाच हनूमन्तं सर्वभूताहिते रता।
en: Thus addressed by Hanumān, the female ascetic practising righteousness, and engaged in the welfare of all beings, replied to Hanumān,

sa: काञ्चनानि च पद्मानि जातानि विमले जले॥ कथं मत्स्याश्च सौवर्णा दृश्यन्ते सह कच्छपैः। आत्मनस्त्वनुभावाद् वा कस्य वैतत्तपोबलम्॥ अजानतां नः सर्वेषां सर्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि।
en: And golden lotuses spring in in lucent water,-how golden fishes are discovered in it along with tortoises! Have these sprung from your power; or do they owe their existence to the ascetic energy of any other? It behoves you to relate all this to us who are ignorant of everything.

sa: कैकेयी त्वब्रवीत्कुब्जां कच्चित्क्षेमं न मन्थरे। विषण्णवदनां हि त्वां लक्षये भृशदुःखिताम्॥
en: And Kaikeyi said to the hump-backed one, Is any evil present, O Mantharā? I do find you with countenance fallen and sore distressed with grief.

sa: सोऽभ्यगच्छन्महातेजाः शबरीं शत्रुसूदनः॥ शबर्या पूजितः सम्यग् रामो दशरथात्मजः।
en: Repairing to Sabarī, that destroyer of foes, gifted with exceeding energy, Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, highly honoured by Sabari.

sa: तस्मै दत्त्वा तदा सिद्धं सर्वं विप्राय निश्चितः। निःशेषितेऽने भगवानभुक्त्वैव महातपाः॥
en: Thereupon he gave it away to the Vipra; and when the rice had been thus exhausted, that worshipful one of mighty austerities went without foot.

sa: आयसं हृदयं नूनं राममातुरसंशयम्। यद् देवगर्भप्रतिमे वनं याति न भिद्यते॥
en: Surely the heart of Rāma's mother is made of iron, for it does not burst on witnessing her son resembling Skanda repairing to the forest.

sa: नह्यस्य वृजिनं किंचिद् दृश्यते सूक्ष्ममप्युत। न दीयते यदि त्वस्य मनसा यदभीप्सितम्॥ विनाशयति त्रैलोक्यं तपसा सचराचरम्। व्याकुलाश्च दिशः सर्वा न च किंचित् प्रकाशते॥
en: Nor do we perceive in him ever so little of anger or lust. And if you do not confer upon him what his mind desire to have, he will annihilate the three worlds with all that is mobile and immobile in them. And the ten cardinal points are disconsolate: and nothing can be discovered therein.

sa: कथं रामो महाबाहुः स तथावितथक्रियः। भक्तं जनमभित्यज्य प्रवासं तापसो गतः॥
en: How could Rāma of mighty arms, resorting to this undesirable course, has gone into exile as an ascetic, leaving behind those that regard him dearly?

sa: साधु राघव मा भूत् ते बुद्धिरेवं निरर्थिका। प्राकृतस्य नरस्येव ह्यार्यबुद्धेस्तपस्विनः॥
en: O Rāghava, endowed with a noble understanding and leading a life of asceticism, do not suffer your intellect to entertain inanities, like any low person.

sa: रामाभिषेकयुक्ताश्च कथाश्चक्रुर्मिथो जनाः। रामाभिषेके सम्प्राप्ते चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च॥ बाला अपि क्रीडमाना गृहद्वारेषु सङ्घशः। रामाभिषवसंयुक्ताश्चक्रुरेव कथा मिथः॥
en: The people began to talk with each other anent the installation of Rāma, and the time for his installation having arrived, on terraces and houses, and doorways boys playing in bodies, conversed with each other concerning the installation of Rāma.

sa: सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च। चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चैत्येष्वट्टलकेषु च॥ नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु वणिजामापणेषु च। कुटुम्बिनां समृद्धेषु श्रीमत्सु भवनेषु च॥ सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेषु च। ध्वजाः समुच्छ्रिताः साधु पताकाश्चाभवंस्तथा॥
en: Standards with pennons were beautifully reared up in the abodes of the gods resembling a peak, enveloped with white clouds, and at the crossing, and on high ways; and over the Caitya tree; and edifices; and over the ware-houses of merchants abounding in goods and the goodly and prosperous mansions of householders, and over all the council-houses and conspicuous trees.

sa: अथ राजा वृतः स्त्रीभिर्दीनाभिर्दीनचेतनः। निर्जगाम प्रियं पुत्रं द्रक्ष्यामीति ब्रुवन् गृहात्॥
en: Then the king, his sense overcome by grief, surrounded by his distressed wives, went out of his house, saying, “I will behold my dear son.”

sa: अयोध्यां गच्छ भरत प्रकृतीरुपरञ्जय। शत्रुघ्नसहितो वीर सह सर्वैद्विजातिभिः॥
en: O Bharata, go to Ayodhyā, and please the subjects, in company with Śatrughna, O hero, and all the regenerate ones.

sa: यदि जीवति वैदेही गमिष्याम्याश्रमं पुनः। संवृत्ता यदि वृत्ता सा प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि लक्ष्मण ॥
en: If Vaidehī live, I will then return to the asylum; but O Lakşmaņa, if that one of excellent character should happen to be dead, I will also renounce my life.

sa: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां न तं पश्यामि शोभते। विक्रमेण नयेद् यस्त्वां मद्बाहुपरिपालिताम्॥
en: O beauteous one, in these three worlds I find no one that can by his might carry you away, who are protected by my arms.

sa: अयं गिरिश्चित्रकूटस्तथा मन्दाकिनी नदी। एतत् प्रकाशते दूरान्नीलमेघनिभं वनम्॥
en: This is the mountain Citrakuta and that the river Mandakinī. And from a distance this forest appears like dark clouds.

sa: हा रामेति जनाः केचिद् राममातेति चापरे। अन्तःपुरसमृद्धं च क्रोशन्तं पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: And seeing the king weeping aloud with the inmates of the inner apartment, some exclaiming "Oh Rama," and others, “O Rāma's mother," began to be-wail.

sa: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्रिं नागेन्द्रमिव कोपितम्। समासाद्याङ्गदस्त्रासाद् विषादमगमत् परम्॥
en: Beholding him like the flaming fire of dissolution and enraged lord of serpents, Angada, out of fear, became exceedingly sorry.

sa: मुनिगुप्तौ च काकुत्स्थौ कथयन्तु नृपाय वै। प्रीतियुक्तं तु राजानमानयन्तु सुशीघ्रगाः॥
en: Let them acquaint the monarch with the welfare of the Kākutsthas protected by the ascetic; and let them, speedily posting hence, bring the delighted king.

sa: अनेन वनवासेन मम प्राप्तं फलद्वयम्। पितुश्चानृण्यता धर्मे भरतस्य प्रियं तथा॥
en: By this banishment of mine, I have gained two things, my father has maintained his truth in religion, and Bharata has obtained his dear interest.

sa: सीतापि चरणांस्तासामुपसंगृह्य दुःखिता। श्वश्रूणामश्रुपूर्णाक्षी सम्बभूवाग्रतः स्थिता॥
en: Sītă also with her eyes filled with tears, law, stood before them in distressful guise.

sa: औपकार्यां स गत्वा तु रघूणां कुलवर्धनम् ॥ ददर्श शिरसा चैनमभिवाद्येदमब्रवीत्।
en: Thereupon, repairing to the camp of that enhancer of the race of the Raghus, he saw Dasaratha, and saluting him with beaded head, addressed him.

sa: वहन्तो जवना रामं भो भो जात्यास्तुरङ्गमाः। निवर्तध्वं न गन्तव्यं हिता भवत भर्तरि॥
en: O you fleet coursers boasting of exalted extraction that bear Rāma away, do you desist, do not go; do you do even what is for the good of your master.

sa: भगीरथात् ककुत्स्थश्च ककुत्स्थाच्च रघुस्तथा। रघोस्तु पुत्रस्तेजस्वी प्रवृद्धः पुरुषादकः॥
en: And from Bhagiratha sprang Kākutstha, and from Kākutstha, Raghu. And Raghu's son was the puissant Pravşdha, feeding on human flesh.

sa: उदङ्मुखः प्रेक्षमाणो ददर्श महतीं चमुम्। गजाश्वरथसम्बाधां यत्तैर्युक्तां पदातिभिः॥
en: And viewing the east, he discovered a mighty army, abounding with elephants, horses and cars, and consisting of equipped infantry.

sa: स शून्यामिव निःशब्दां दृष्ट्वा परमदुर्मनाः। सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास शोकवेगसमाहतः॥ कच्चिन सगजा साश्वा सजना सजनाधिपा। रामसंतापदुःखेन दग्धा शोकाग्निना पुरी।७।।
en: And beholding it empty and still, Sumantra afflicted with exceeding sorrow, and overwhelmed with grief, thought, “Perhaps the city with her elephants and horses and men and king has been consumed by the fire of grief on account of Rāma."

sa: पूर्वमेव मया सृष्टो जाम्बवानृक्षपुङ्गवः। जृम्भमाणस्य सहसा मम वक्त्रादजायत।७।।
en: Formerly I had created that foremost of bears, Jāmbavān, who suddenly came out of my mouth as I was yawning.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु सा चिन्तां मैथिली समुपागता। स्नापयन्तीव गामुष्णैरश्रुभिर्नयनच्युतैः॥
en: Being accosted thus, Maithili was wrapt up in thought and bathed her breast with tears trickling down from her eyes.

sa: जातमात्रे कुमारे तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी। महागम्भीरनिर्घोषा नभो नादयती तदा॥
en: As soon as the prince was born, an invisible voice filled the whole sky with a laud and deep roar.

sa: किमुद्यमं व्यर्थमिमं कृत्वा ते राक्षसाधिप। दृष्टश्चेत् त्वं रणे तेन तदन्तमुपजीवितम्॥
en: Of what avail is this vain attempt O Rākşasa chief? No sooner Rāma shall see you in the battle you shall meet with your end.

sa: गतेषु पृथिवीशेषु राजा दशरथः पुनः। प्रविवेश पुरीं श्रीमान् पुरस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमान्॥
en: When the lords of the earth had gone away, the graceful king Dasaratha re-entered his palace, with the foremost of regenerate ones at his head.

sa: ततस्तमन्तःपुरनादमुत्थितं समीक्ष्य वृद्धास्तरुणाश्च मानवाः। स्त्रियश्च सर्वा रुरुदुः समन्ततः पुरं तदासीत् पुनरेव संकुलम्॥
en: Hearing the sounds of wailing arise from the inner apartment, old and young as well as females, set up lamentations all round; and the city was again filled with them.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः। प्रत्युवाच महातेजा मारीचो राक्षसेश्वरम्॥
en: Hearing the words of that sovereign of the Rākşasas, the highly energetic Mārica, skilled in speech, answered the Raksasa chief.

sa: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण निरालम्बनमम्बरम्। सहसा निपतिष्यामि घनाद् विद्युदिवोत्थिता॥
en: In the twing an eye I shall spread through the unsupported lightning darting from clouds.

sa: ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यतां प्रति। गुणानित्येव तान् विद्धि तव स्नेहपुरस्कृता॥
en: The evils, thus enumerated by you of living in the forest, do you know, appear as so many good qualities to me, who have been made forward by your affection.

sa: स इदानीमहं वृद्धः परिहीनपराक्रमः। साम्प्रतं कालमस्माकं भवान् सर्वगुणान्वितः॥
en: But now I have grown old, and prowess has left me. At present we have you, furnish with every virtue.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहस्य व्यास: सत्यवतीसुतः॥ आजगाम महातेजा नगरं नागसाह्वयम्।
en: Then, after a few days, Vyasa, the son of Satyavati, gifted with great cnergy, came to the city of Hastinapur.

sa: कच्चित् कुशलकामासि राज्ञोऽस्य भुजगात्मजे। मम वा चपलापाङ्गि कच्चित् त्वं शुभमिच्छसि॥
en: Do you entertain friendly motives towards this king, O daughter of a snake? O you of restless glances, do you wish good to me too?

sa: कालेनायं जनः सर्वो निहतो रणमूर्धनि। वयं च कालेन हताः कालो हि परमेश्वरः॥
en: All those who have fallen on the field of battlc have really been killed by Time. Indeed, all of us have been killed by Time. Time is indeed, all powerful.

sa: नन्दीश्वरस्य मूर्ति तु दृष्ट्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषैः। स्वर्गमार्गे नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति॥
en: One who succeeds in seeing the image of Nandishvara, becomes purged of all sins. Bathing in the tirtha called svargamarga one is sure to proceed to the regions of Brahman.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच समयेन बिसानीतो गृह्णीध्वं कामकारतः। एकैको नाम मे प्रोक्त्वा ततो गृह्णीत माचिरम्॥
en: Yatudhani said According to agreement, do you take he lotusstalks as you please. You must, one by one, give me your names. You may then, without delay, take the stalks!

sa: च्यवन उवाच राजन् नार्हाम्यहं कोटि भूयो वापि महाद्युते। सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यं ब्राह्मणैः सह चिन्तय॥
en: Chyavana said O king, I am not with a crore of coins or even more. Let that price be given to these men which would be fair or proper. Do you consult with the Brahmanas.

sa: स तथा बाध्यमानो वै संवर्तेन महीपतिः। अन्वगादेव तमृषि प्राञ्जलिः सम्प्रसादयन्॥
en: And though thus worried and oppressed by Samvarta, the king followed that sage with his hands joined together in prayer and endeavouring to plcase him.

sa: गावो नवतृणानीव गृह्णन्त्येता नवं नवम्। शम्बरस्य च या माया माया या नमुचेरपि॥
en: The women have in them the sum total of that illusion which the Asura Shambara possessed, that illusion which the Asura Namuchi possessed, that illusion which Bali or Kumbhinasi had.

sa: ऋषयश्चापि ते सर्वे नारदप्रमुखास्तदा। प्रतिगृह्याभ्यनन्दन्त तद्वाक्यं प्रतिपूज्य च॥
en: The Rishis also headed by Narada, accepted and highly spoke of the words of Bhishma and approved of them joyfully.

sa: कुले स्रोतसि संच्छन्ने यस्य स्याद् योनिसंकरः। संश्रयत्येव तच्छीलं नरोऽल्पमथवा बहु॥
en: However secret may one's birth be, if that birth happens to be impure, its character or nature is sure to show itself slightly or largely.

sa: अमृतं ह्यव्ययं दिव्यं क्षरन्ति च वहन्ति च। अमृतायतनं चैताः सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः॥
en: They bear and yield excellent and strength giving ambrosia. They receive the adoration of all the worlds and are considered as the source of nectar.

sa: ऋषयश्चापि देवाश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा। लिङ्गमेवार्चयन्ति स्म यत् तदूर्ध्वं समास्थितम्॥
en: The Rishis, the celestials, the Gandharvas, and the Apsaras, adore that emblem of his which is every erect and upraised.

sa: अहो दानं घुष्यते ते स्वर्गे स्वर्गनिवासिभिः॥ गगनात् पुरुषवर्षं च पश्येदं पतितं भुवि।
en: Indeed, this gift of yours is being bruited about in Heaven by the dwellers of that happy region. Mark, flowers have been rained down from the sky on the Earth.

sa: नाचिकेतं पिता दृष्ट्वा पतितं दुःखमूच्छितः। किं मया कृतमित्युक्त्वा निपपात महीतले॥
en: Seeing Nachiketa prostrated upon the earth, his father become senseless with grief. He, too, exclaiming, Alas, what have I done! dropped down on the earth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्ते स तदा तेन यमदूतेन वै गृहान्। नीतश्च कारयामास सर्वं तद् यमशासनम्॥
en: Bhishma said After Yama had said these words to him, the messenger who had borne him from his house conveyed him back to it. The Brahmana, on his return, obeyed the instructions he had received.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। ब्राह्मणस्य च संवादं यमस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma Said : Regarding it, O Yudhishthira, is recited the discourse that took place forinerly between a Brahmana and Yama.

sa: यः कश्चिदिह लोकेऽस्मिन्नागमः परिकीर्तितः। तस्यान्तगमनं श्रेयः कीर्तिरेषा सनातनी॥
en: The observance of every system of rules is prescribed in this world. Such observance has always been highly spoken of.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव तु ध्यात्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। उवाच मातरं दीनश्चिन्ताशोकपरायणः॥
en: Having thought for a inoment, king Yudhishthira just, dispirited and plunged in anxiety and sorrow, said to his mother, saying,

sa: क्षपयामास तं कालं कृच्छ्रप्राणो द्विजोत्तमः। अथ षष्ठे गते काले यवप्रस्थमुपार्जयन्॥
en: That best of Brahmanas passed the days in terrible suffering. One day, after the sixth division came, he succeeded in getting a prastha of barley.

sa: एवं शुश्राव वदतां गिरो जिष्णुरुदारधीः। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु व्रजारिष्टं पुनश्चैहीति भारत॥
en: These were the words which the intelligent Jishnu heard. The citizens also blessed him, saying, 'Let blessings be yours'. Go safely and return O Bharata.'

sa: अटवीपर्वताश्चैव नद्यस्तीर्थानि यानि च॥ सर्वाण्यस्वामिकान्याहुन हि तत्र परिग्रहः।
en: Forests, mountains, rivers, and Tirthas, are considered as having no owners. No earth need be bought here for performing Shraddhas.

sa: अवश्यं करणीयं हि गुरोरिह हि शासनम्॥ यदि त्वेतदहं कुर्यामाश्चर्ये स्यात् कृतं मया।
en: The command of my preceptor should certainly be obeyed by me. If, therefore, I protect her by my Yogapower, the feat will be considered by all as a wonderful one.

sa: व्यादिशन्तु च किं विप्राः प्रायश्चित्तमिहाद्य मे। सुनृशंसस्य पापस्य पितृहन्तू रणाजिरे॥
en: Let the Brahmanas direct what expiation should now be done by me, a cruel and sinful wretch, who has killed his own father in battle.

sa: ततोऽगस्त्यश्च कण्वश्च भृगुरत्रिर्वृषाकपिः॥ असितो देवलश्चैव देवयज्ञमुपागमन्।
en: Then there came to that place Agastya, Kanva, Bhrigu, Atri, and Vrishakapi, Asita and Devala.

sa: तथैवाप्सरसामङ्के प्रतिसुप्तः प्रबोध्यते॥ नूपुराणां निनादेन मेखलानां च नि:स्वनैः।
en: He sleeps on the lap of Apsaras and is awakened every morning by the melodious sound of Nupuras and Kanchis.

sa: पुनः प्रविश्य नगरं दंशितः स नृपोत्तमः। आरुह्य नागप्रवरं निर्ययौ रणकर्कशः॥
en: Once more entering his capital, that foremost of kings, irresistible in battle, cased himself in mail, and mounting on his prince of elephants, came out.

sa: जालं ते योजयामासुनिःशेषेण जनाधिप। मत्स्योदकं समासाद्य तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Arrived at that water which, contained many fish, those fishermen, O chief of the Bharatas, tied all their nets together.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रूयतां राजशार्दूल महदाश्चर्यमुत्तमम्। अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे निवृत्ते यदभूत् प्रभो॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hear, O chief of kings, of a most wonderful event which took place, O powerful monarch, at the conclusion of that great Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: अत्र मे दुर्योधनापराधेन वसुधा वसुधाधिपाः। प्रनष्टा योजयित्वास्मानकी, मुनिसत्तम॥
en: Through Duryodhana's folly, O best of ascetics, the kings of the Earth have met with destruction, and we with ignominy.

sa: इदमङ्गिरसा पूर्वं महर्षिभ्यः प्रदर्शितम्। यः प्रदर्शयते नित्यं न स दुःखमवाप्नुते॥
en: Forinerly Angirasa declared so to the great Rishis. The man who teaches another the merit of fasts, has never to suffer any sort of misery.

sa: उपासते यथा बाला मातरं क्षुधयार्दिताः। श्रेयस्कामास्तथा गङ्गामुपासन्तीह देहिनः॥
en: As children stricken with hunger, solicit their mothers for food, similarly do people desirous of their highest good seek Ganga.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षो धागासीत् साधु साध्विति भारत॥ तथैव द्विजसंघानां शंसतां विवभौ स्वनः।
en: Then, O Bharata, an invisible voice was heard in the sky, saying, 'Excellent, Excellent!' The murmurs, also, of crowd of Brahmanas as they spoke, arose.

sa: वियोगे दोषदर्शी यः संयोगं स विसर्जयेत्। असङ्गे सङ्गमो नास्ति दुःखं भुवि वियोगजम्॥
en: He who sees evil in separation should give up union. By standing aloof, no unions are formed, and sorrow is renounced, for sorrow in the worlds is born of separation.

sa: आपो मूलं फलं मांसम्मनं वापि पितृक्षये। यत् किंचिन्मधुसम्मिश्रं तदानन्त्याय कल्पते।॥
en: Even a little of water, roots, fruits, meat, and rice, mixed with honey, if offered on the anniversary of the day of death, becomes endless.

sa: पितामह उवाच अहो धर्मो महाभागे सरहस्य उदाहृतः। वरं ददामि ते धन्ये तपस्ते वर्धतां सदा॥
en: Brahman said O highly blessed one, excellent is the duty that you have described together with its secret ritual. Praise be to you! I grant you a boon, viz., that your penances always may increase.

sa: कविः काव्यश्च घृष्णुश्च बुद्धिमानूशना तथा। भृगुश्च विरजाश्चैव काशी चोग्रश्च धर्मवित्॥
en: The names of the eight sons of Kavi are Kavi, Kavya, Dhrishnu, Ushanas endued with great intelligence, Bhrigu, Viraja, Kashi, and Ugra knowing every duty.

sa: सम्यगाराधितः पुत्र त्वया प्रवदतां वर॥ न हि ते वृजिनं किंचित् सुसूक्ष्ममपि विद्यते।
en: I have been properly honoured and adored, O son, by you, O foremost of all persons gifted with speech. You have no sin, not even a minute one, in you.

sa: त्रीणि वर्षाण्युदीक्षेत कन्या ऋतुमती सती। चतुर्थे त्वथ सम्प्राप्ते स्वयं भर्तारमर्जयेत्॥
en: After puberty, it in, the girl (if not married) should wait for three years. On the fourth year, she should look for a husband herself.

sa: का नु तासां वरस्त्रीणां समवस्था भविष्यति। या हीनाः पतिभिः पुत्रैर्मातुलैर्भ्रातृभिस्तथा॥
en: Alas, what will the condition be of those foremost ladies who have been deprived by us of husbands and sons and maternal uncles and brothers?

sa: दिशो वायू रविश्चन्द्रः पृथ्व्यग्नी विष्णुरेव च। इन्द्रः प्रजापतिर्मित्रमग्नयो दश भामिनि॥
en: The points of the compass, wind, Sun, Moon, earth, fire, Vishnu, Indra, Prajapati, and was Mitra, these, O beautiful one, are the ten (sacrificial) fires.

sa: ये तु निन्दन्ति जल्पेषु न ताञ्छ्राद्धेषु भोजयेत्। ब्राह्मणा निन्दिता राजन् हन्युस्त्रैपुरुषं कुलम्॥
en: The offerings made at Shraddhas, should be given to those who are devoted to knowledge. Indeed, they are to be considered as men who never speak ill of the Brahmanas.

sa: न जातु विषमं चैव गमिष्यति कदाचन॥ चत्वारः सचिवा यस्य भ्रातरो विपुलौजसः। लोकपालसमा ह्येते सर्वधर्मार्थदर्शिनः॥
en: He who has, four such brothers of abundant prowess, for his counselors will never fall into distress. All of them are conversant with both Virtue and Profit, and resemble the very guardians of the world.

sa: उभौ लोकौ हतौ मत्वा ते देवा दुःखिताऽभवन्। शोकाश्चि महात्मानं ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः॥
en: Deprived previously of Heaven and now of the Earth also, the gods became very dispirited. Indeed, those great ones, afflicted with grief, then threw themselves unreservedly upon the Grandfather's protection.

sa: इयं च कृपणा वृद्धा हतपुत्रा तपस्विनी॥ गान्धारी पुत्रशोकार्ता युष्मान् याचति वै मया।
en: This Gandhari, also is dispirited and old. She. too, has lost her children and is helpless. Stricken with grief or the loss of her hens, she solicits you with me.

sa: तथा विविशतुश्चोभौ सम्प्रहृष्टनराकुलम्। तौ गत्वा धृतराष्ट्रस्य गृहं शक्रगृहोपमम्॥
en: They then, with cheerful hearts, and without any anxiety, entered the palace of Dhritarashtra which resembled the mansion of Shakra.

sa: न सत्यं विन्दते कश्चित् क्षेत्रज्ञस्त्वेव विन्दति। गुणानां गुणभूतानां यत् परं परमं महत्॥
en: No one else, but the Kshetrajna, comes by that which is the highest and great and which is above the qualities and those entities which are born of the qualities.

sa: ततः प्रतीतमनसो ब्राह्मणाः कुरुजाङ्गलाः॥ क्षत्रियाश्चैव वैश्याश्च शूद्राश्चैव समाययुः।
en: Many Brahmanas living in Kurujangala, many Kshatriyas, many Vaishyas, and many Shudras also, came to Dhritarashtra' place, with gratified hearts.

sa: अलंकृतास्त्रयो लोकाः पथिभिर्विमलैस्त्रिभिः। यस्तु तस्या जलं सेवेत् कृतकृत्यः पुमान् भवेत्॥७३
en: The three regions are beautiful by the three courses of this sacred river. The man who uses the waters of that river, becomes certainly successful.

sa: बलं श्रोत्रे वाङ्मनश्चक्षुषी च ज्ञानं तथा सविशुद्धं ममाद्य। देहन्यासो नातिचिरान्मतो मे न चाति तूर्णं सविताद्य याति॥
en: My strength, cars, speech, mind, eyes, and that clear understanding of mine, are all clouded today. I think the time is not distant when I shall have to renounce my body. The Sun seems to me to go very slowly.

sa: प्रसाद्य ब्राह्मणं ते तु पाद्यमर्थ्य निवेद्य च। प्रायच्छन् कुण्डले दिव्ये पन्नगाः परमार्चिते॥
en: Having pleased that Brahmana and offered him water to wash his feet and the ingredients of the Arghya (for honouring him), the Nagas gave him those celestial and highly-adored earrings.

sa: विमुक्तः सर्वसंस्कारैः सर्वद्वन्द्वविवर्जितः। विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्॥
en: Freed from all impressions, divested of all Pairs of opposites, freed froin all sins, he। attains to the highest goal.

sa: ततो मुनिगणाः सर्वे नारदं देवदर्शनम्। तदा नियोजयामासुर्वचने वाक्यकोविदम्॥
en: all those ascetics then appointed Narada, that foremost of all persons conversant with words, to satisfy the request of Vasudeva.

sa: वर्जयन्ति हि मांसानि मासश: पक्षशोऽपि वा। तेषां हिंसानिवृत्तानां ब्रह्मलोको विधीयते॥
en: They who abstain from flesh by either months or fortnights, have the region of Brahma ordained for them on account of their abstention from cruelty.

sa: घ्राणश्चक्षुश्च जिह्वा च त्वक् श्रोत्रं चैव पञ्चमम्। मनो बुद्धिश्च सप्तैते होतारः पृथगाश्रिताः॥
en: The nose, the eye, the tongue, the skin, and the ear numbering the fifth, the mind, and the understanding, these are the seven sacrificing priests standing distinctly from one another.

sa: सूक्ष्मेऽवकाशे तिष्ठन्तो न पश्यन्तीतरेतरम्। एतान् वै सप्तहोतूंस्त्व स्वभावाद् विद्धि शोभने॥
en: Living in subtle space, they do not perceive one another. Do you, O beautiful one, know these sacrificing priests that are scven by their nature.

sa: यो ब्रह्मदेयां तु ददाति कन्यां भूमिप्रदानं च करोति विप्रे। ददाति चान्नं विधिवच्च यश्च स लोकमाप्नोति पुरंदरस्य॥
en: He who confers a daughter according to the Brahma form upon an eligible person, or who makes a gift of land to a Brahmana, or who gives food according to due rites, succeeds in attaining to the region of Indra.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यन्मूलं सर्वधर्माणां स्वजनस्य गृहस्य च। पितृदेवातिथीनां च तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me of that, O grandfather, which is the root of all duties, which is the root of kinsmen of home, of the departed manes and of guests.

sa: ध्राणं चक्षुस्तथा श्रोत्रं वाङ्मनो बुद्धिरेव च। न रसानधिगच्छन्ति जिह्वा तानधिगच्छति॥
en: The nose, the eye, the ear too, the skin, the mind, and the understanding, never succeed in apprehending tastes. The tonguc alone apprehends them. never

sa: रुद्रस्तु तेजोऽप्रतिमं धारयामास वै तदा। प्रस्कन्नं तु ततस्तस्मात् किंचित्तत्रापतद् भुवि॥
en: Rudra begged them, held in himself his energy of incomparable power. A small quantity, however, that came out o this body dropped on the Earth.

sa: आपदश्चापि बोद्वव्या बहुरूपा नराधिप। भवन्ति राज्ञा कौरव्य यास्ताः पृथगतः शृणु॥
en: Calamity, O king, with which rulers are overtaken, is of many forms. Listen, O you of Kuru's race, as to what those various forms are.

sa: रथस्थं तु महातेजा वासुदेवं धनंजयः। पुनरेवाव्रवीद् वाक्यमिदं भरतसत्तम॥
en: To Vasudeva seated on the car, the highly energetic Dhananjaya once more said these words, O chief of the Bharatas.

sa: इत्युक्तः स नृपो देव्या द्रौपद्या भरतर्षभ। सेनाध्यक्षान् समानाय्या सर्वानिदमुवाच ह॥
en: Thus addressed by queen Draupadi, the king, O chief of Bharata's race, summoned all the leaders of his army to his presence and told them.

sa: इत्युक्ताः सैनिकास्ते तु सज्जीभूता विशाम्पते। आचख्युः सज्जमित्येवं पार्थायामिततेजसे॥
en: Thus addressed, O king, the army got themselves ready, and informed Pritha's son of immeasurable energy, saying, Everything is ready.

sa: तस्मिंस्ते पृथिवीपाला द्रोणपार्षतसंगरे। नानादिगागता वीराः प्रायशो निधनं गताः॥
en: In that battle between Drona and the son of Prishata, the kings assembled from various realms were nearly rooted out.

sa: तत्र गत्वा महात्मानं यदि ते रोचतेऽर्जुन। अस्मद्गमनसंयुक्तं वचो ब्रूहि जनाधिपम्॥
en: And now, O Arjuna, if it pleases you, do you go to that great prince and tell him of my desire to leave this place.

sa: त्वयाशक्या च दुर्वृत्त्या रक्षितुं प्रमदा द्विजा न च त्वं कृतवान् किंचिदतः प्रीतोऽस्मि तेन ते॥
en: You were fully capable, O twiceborn one, of protecting my wife whose disposition, by nature is sinful. In doing what you did, you did not commit any sin I was for this, pleased with you.

sa: पौरजानपदानां न शौचाशौचे युधिष्ठिर॥ यथा स्याद् विदितं राजंस्तथा कार्यं कुरूद्वह।
en: You should, O Yudhishthira, act in such a manner as to determine the merits and faults of the inhabitants of your city and the provinces.

sa: स तत्र राजा तं वीरं शरसंधैरनेकशः। अर्दयामास निशितैराशीविषविषोपमैः॥
en: The king afflicted the hero with repeated showers of arrows gifted with whetted points and resembling snakes of dreadful poison.

sa: यस्तु क्षत्रगतो देवि मया धर्म उदीरितः। तमहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे शृणु समाहिता॥
en: Do you listen to me with rapt attention, O goddess, for I shall now tell you what the dutics are of the Kshatriya and about which you have asked me.

sa: न सा प्रीतिर्दिविष्ठस्य सर्वकामानुपाश्नतः। सम्भवेद् या परा प्रीतिर्गङ्गायाः पुलिने नृणाम्॥
en: The high happiness which one enjoys by living on the banks of Ganga, can never be his who is living even in the celestial region.

sa: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थोऽथ भिक्षुकः। चत्वार आश्रमाः प्रोक्ताः सर्वे गार्हस्थ्यमूलकाः॥
en: The householder, the Brahmacharin the hermit and the mendicant, these are modes of life have all been said to the householder's mode for their root.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्मुनिभिस्तैस्तपोधनैः। समाश्वस्यत राजर्षिर्हतबन्धुर्युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Those great ascetics consoled the royal saint Yudhishthira, bereft of his friends with these words.

sa: स त्वमिष्ट्वा महायज्ञैः समृद्धैराप्तदक्षिणैः। कीर्ति लोके परां प्राप्य गतिमय्यां गमिष्यसि॥
en: Therefore, should you perform inagnificent sacrifices with presents, so that you may attain fame in this world, and reach the perfect way in the next.

sa: निवापैर्दीयमानैश्च चातुर्वर्ण्यन भारत। तर्पिताः पितरो देवास्तवान्नं जरयन्ति वै॥
en: On account, however, of the offerings made by persons of all classes, the departed Manes began to digest that food.

sa: मानुषेषु च कुर्वाणाः प्रजा: कर्म शुभास्तव। निवत्स्यन्ति महाभागे सर्वा दुहितश्च ते॥ मनसा चिन्तिता भोगास्वत्वया वै दिव्यमानुषाः। यच्च सर्वं सुखं देवि तत् ते सम्पत्स्यते शुभे॥
en: You will readily get all kinds of enjoyment, celestial and human, that you may think of. You will get whatever happiness exists in the celestial region, O blessed one! The regions, O you of a hundred eyes, that are Surabhi's are replete with means for the satisfaction of every desire, Neither Death, nor Decrepitude, nor fire, can overcome its inhabitants.

sa: देवा ऊचुः निवापान्नेन भगवन् भृशं पीड्यामहे वयम्। प्रसादं कुरु नो देव श्रेयो नः संविधीयताम्॥
en: The gods said o illustrious one, with the food that is offered us in sacrifices and Shraddhas, we are suffering very much. O lord, show us favour and do what would be for our behoof.

sa: शमस्तूपरमो धर्मः प्रवृत्तः सत्सु नित्यशः। गृहस्थानां विशुद्धानां धर्मस्य निचयो महान्॥
en: Tranquillity of mind is a great duty that is in vogue among the righteous. Householders of pure mind are capable of acquiring very great merit.

sa: तेन त्वमासां माहात्म्यं न वेत्सि शृणु यत् प्रभो। गवां प्रभावं परमं माहात्म्यं च सुरर्षभ॥
en: Hence, you are not acquainted with glorious pereminence of kine. Listen now to me, o powerful one, as I explain to you the great energy and glorious pereminence of kine, O king of the celestials.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। पितामहस्य संवादमिन्द्रस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is recited the ancient discourse between the Grandfather and chief of the celestials.

sa: पूर्वं तु मनसा त्यक्त्वा तथा वाचाऽथ कर्मणा। न भक्षयति सो मांसं त्रिविधं स विमुच्यते॥
en: Discarding it mentally in the beginning, one should next discard it in word and thought. He who according to this rule, abstains from eating meat is said to be purified in a three fold way.

sa: एवं गोशकृतः पुत्र माहात्म्यं तेऽनुवर्णितम्। माहात्म्यं च गवां भूयः श्रूयतां गदतो मम॥
en: I have thus told you, O son, the glory of the dung of kine. I shall once again describe to you the glory of kine. Do you listen to me.

sa: पुष्टिरायुस्तथा वीर्यं श्रीश्चैव पितृभक्तितः। पितामहः पुलस्त्यश्च वसिष्ठः पुलहस्तथा॥ अङ्गिराश्च क्रतुश्चैव कश्यपश्च महानृषिः। एते कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ महायोगेश्वराः स्मृताः॥
en: Growth, longevity, energy, and prosperity became all attainable through devotion to the departea Manes. The Grandfather Brahman, Pulastya, Vasishtha, Pulaha, Angirasa, Kratu, and the great Rishi Kashyapa, these O prince of Kuru's race, are considered as great masters of Yoga.

sa: विश्वसृग्भ्यस्तु भूतेभ्यो महाभूतास्तु सर्वशः। भूतेभ्यश्चापि पञ्चभ्यो मुक्तो गच्छेत् परां गतिम्॥
en: All the great elements are beyond those elements which form the universe. He who is released from those five clements goes to the highest goal.

sa: तैराख्यातेन मार्गेण ततस्ते जग्मुरञ्जसा। ददृशुश्चाविदूरे तान् सर्वानथ पदातयः॥
en: Proceeding quickly on foot along the path pointed out by them, the Pandavas saw all of them from a distance.

sa: गौ उवाच अवश्यं मानना कार्या तवास्माभिर्यशास्विनि। शकृन्मूत्रे निवस त्वं पुण्यमेतद्धि नः शुभे॥
en: The kine said you of great fame, it is certainly desirable that we should honour you! Do you live in our urine and dung. Both these are sacred, O goddess.

sa: पुनरेव च विप्रर्षिः प्रोवाच कुशिकं नृपम्। सभार्यो मां रथेनाशु वह यत्र ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: Then addressing king Kushika, the twice born Rishi said to him, “Do you with your spouse, yoke yourself to a car and take me on it wherever I shall direct."

sa: नित्यसंस्कृतमन्नं तु विविधं राजवेश्मनि। शयनानि च मुख्यानि परिषेकाश्च पुष्कला:॥ वस्त्रं च विविधाकारमभवत् समुपार्जितम्। न शशाक ततो द्रष्टुमन्तरं च्यवनस्तदा॥
en: Every day, good and pure food of various sorts, excellent beds, profuse articles needed for bath, and cloths of various sorts, were collected and kept ready in the palace for the Rishi. Indeed, Chyavana could not find any fault in the conduct of the king.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा तु पुत्रस्य वचः शूरात्मजस्तदा। विहाय शोकं धर्मात्मा ददौ श्राद्धमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of his son, Vasudeva, that descendant of Shura, of righteous soul renouncing grief, made excellent obsequial offerings (to Abhimanyu).

sa: अहमप्येतदेव त्वां ब्रवीमि कुरु मे वचः। अनुज्ञां लभतां राजा मा वृथेह मरिष्यति॥
en: I also tell you (what the old king says.) Do you obey my words. Let the old king have your permission. Let him not die an inglorious death at home.

sa: येन देवाः पवित्रेण भुञ्जते लोकमुत्तमम्। यत् पवित्रं पवित्राणां तद् घृतं शिरसा वहेत्॥
en: Thatsacred thing by whose help the celestials enjoy regions of happiness, that which is most sacred of all sacred things, viz., clarified butter, should then be carried on the head.

sa: यस्य विप्रास्तु शंसन्ति साधोभूमि सदैव हि। न तस्य शत्रवो राजन् प्रशंसन्ति वसुन्धराम्॥
en: That pious king about whom the Brahmanas say——We live on earth given to us by him, is such that his very enemies cannot utter the least reproach about his kingdom.

sa: परस्वहरणे दोषाः सर्व एव प्रकीर्तिताः। एतद्धि लेशमात्रेण कथितं ते मयाऽनद्य॥
en: I have told you all the faults of the misappropriation of others' properties. I have described to you very briefly the subject, O sinless one.

sa: तेषां प्रद्रवमाणानामुपदेशार्थमात्मनः। सर्याणां दंशने भावः प्रवृत्तः पूर्वमेव तु॥
en: Amongst them that thus ran in all directions from desire of sclf-instruction, the tendency for biting first arose in snakes.

sa: मातरं पितरं चैव शुश्रूषन्ति जितेन्द्रियाः। भ्रातृणां चैव सस्नेहास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who wait humbly upon their parents, who have controlled their senses, and who are affectionate towards their brothers, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: विश्वासेन तु निक्षिप्तं यो विनिहोति मानवः। स गतायुर्नरस्तात मत्स्ययोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: That man who misappropriates trust property, has to suffer a diminution in the period of his life and dying has to take birth ainong fishes.

sa: मत्स्यमांसमथो हृत्वा काको जायति दुर्मतिः। लवणं चोरयित्वा तु चिरिकाकः प्रजायते॥
en: That wicked man who steals fish has to take birth as a crow. By stealing salt one has to take birth as an imitating parrot.

sa: एवंगुण: सम्बभूवेह राजा यस्य क्रतो तत् सुवर्णं प्रभूतम्। तत् त्वं समादाय नरेन्द्र वित्तं यजस्य देवांस्तर्पयानो निवापैः॥
en: So virtuous in this world was that king, at whose sacrifice such an enormous quantity of gold was collected, and now, O prince you must collect that gold and adoring the gods with due rites, do you celebrate this sacrifice.

sa: लंबतेऽवाशिरा यस्तु युगानामयुतं पुमान्। तिष्ठेद् यथेष्टं यश्चापि गङ्गायां स विशिष्यते॥
en: One who lives permanently by the side of Ganga is superior in merit to one who lives for ten thousand cycles with head hanging downwards.

sa: विमानेषु विचित्रेषु रमणीयेषु भारत। मोदन्ते पुण्यकर्माणो विहरन्तो यशस्विनः॥
en: Pious and illustrious persons sport there happily, moving from place to place, O Bharata, on delightful and highly beautiful cars.

sa: तेषां लोका हापर्यन्ताः सदने ब्रह्मणः स्मृताः। उपस्थिता ह्यप्सरसो गन्धर्वेश्च जनाधिप॥
en: Such man acquire many regions of happiness in the abode of Brahman himself, There, o king, they live in the company of Apsaras and Gandharvas.

sa: अंशुकं चोरयित्वा तु शुको जायति मानवः। चोरयित्वा दुकूलं तु मृतो हंसः प्रजायते॥
en: By stealing a picce of muslin, one becomes a parrot. By stealing a piece of cloth that is of fine texture one becomes a swan after renouncing his human body.

sa: वसत्सु वृष्णिवीरेषु तत्राथ जनमेजय। जज्ञे तव पिता राजन् परिक्षित् परवीरहा॥
en: It was while the Vrishni heroes, ) Janamejaya, were living in the Kuru-city, O king, that your father, that destroyer of hostile heroes, was born.

sa: ततः सोऽतित्वरः कृष्णो विवेशान्तःपुरं तदा। युयुधानद्वितीयो वै व्यथितेन्द्रियमानसः॥
en: Krishna, his senses and inind considerably affected, with Yuyudhana in his company, entered speedily the inner apartments of the palace.

sa: यतिरुवाच प्राणैर्वियोगे च्छागस्य यदि श्रेयः प्रपश्यसि। छागार्थे वर्तते यज्ञो भवतः किं प्रयोजनम्॥
en: The Yati said-If you see such good to the goat in this dissociation with (his) vital airs, then this sacrifice is for the goat. What need have you for it?

sa: ये न धनानि न वासांसि न भोगान् न च काञ्चनम्। न गावो नानविकृति प्रयच्छन्ति कदाचन॥ अप्रवृत्ताश्च लुब्धा नास्तिका दानवर्जिताः। एवंभूता नरा देवि निरयं यान्त्यबुद्धयः॥
en: They never make gifts of wealth or dresses, or viands, or gold, or kine, or any kind of food. Those men who are disinclined to relieve the distress of others, who are full of cupidity, who have no faith in the scriptures, and who do not make gifts. Verily, these of little understanding, O goddess, have to sink in Hell.

sa: पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं ज्ञातीनां च सहस्रशः। कथाभिः शमयामास पार्थं शौरिर्जनार्दन॥
en: And then Janardana consoled the son of Pritha afflicted by the death of his sons, and thousands of other relatives.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry success.

sa: मरुत उवाच त्वं चैवैतद् वेत्थ पुरंदरच विश्वेदेवा वसवश्चाश्विनौ च। मित्रद्रोहे निष्कृतिर्नास्ति लोके महत् पापं ब्रह्महत्यासमं तत्॥
en: Marutta said-You, O Purandara, the Vishvadevas, the Vasus and the Ashvins you all know, that, in this world there is no escape for the results of playing false to a friend, it is a great sin like that of Brahminicide.

sa: नाभूमिपतिना भूमिरधिष्ठेया कथंचन। न चापात्रेण वा ग्राह्या दत्तेदाने न चाचरेत्॥
en: None but a lord of Earth can make gifts of carth. Nor should one who is not a worthy person accept a gift of earth.

sa: अग्नि उवाच दिवं राजन् पृथिवीं च सर्वा संवेष्टयेस्त्वं स्वबलेनैव शक्र। एवंविधस्येह सतस्तवासौ कथं वृत्रस्त्रिदिवं प्राग् जहा॥
en: You, O Shakra, have encompassed the dominion of the heaven and the earth and the sky by the strength of your own arms, but even thus how could Vritra (of old) wrest from you the sovereignty of the celestial regions?

sa: प्रसादयामास च तमगस्त्यं त्रिदशेश्वरः। स्वयमभ्येत्य राजर्षे पुरस्कृत्य बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: Placing Brihaspati be one him, the king of the deities came there, O royal sage, and pleased the Rishi Agastya.

sa: अन्यथा बहुबुद्ध्याढ्यो वाक्यं वदति संसदि। अन्यथैव ह्यहंवादी दुर्बलं वदते वचः॥
en: A proud man, even when gifted with intelligence, by speaking in the midst of an assembly otherwise, finds himself uttering only words of weak meaning.

sa: देवशर्मन् उवाच किं ते विपुल दृष्टं वै तस्मिन् शिष्य महावने। ते त्वां जानन्ति विपुल आत्मा च रुचिरेव च॥
en: Devasharman said What have you seen, O Vipula, in course of your journey. O disciple, through the great forest? Then whom you have seen knew, you, O Vipula. I, as also my wife Ruchi, know how you had acted in the matter of protecting Ruchi.

sa: ईश्वर उवाच पितामहादपि वरः शाश्वतः पुरुषो हरिः। कृष्णो जाम्बूनदाभासो व्यभ्रे सूर्य इवोदितः॥
en: Maheshvara said Hari is superior to the Grandfather himself. He is the Eternal Purusha. Otherwise called Krishna, He is cndued with the splendour of gold and gifted with solar effulgence.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य शिष्यं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। देवशर्मा महातेजा यत् तच्छृणु जनाधिप॥
en: Bhishma said Seeing his disciple returned from his mission, Devasharman of great energy addressed him in words which I shall recite to you, O king.

sa: स एनं रणमध्यस्थः शरैः पातयिता शुवि। एवं कृते स नागेन्द्र मुक्तशापो भविष्यति॥
en: He will, standing on the field of battle, cast Dhananjaya down on the Earth. When this will take place, O Prince of Snakes, Arjuna will be freed from our curse!

sa: विश्वामित्र उवाच कामं कामयमानस्य यदा कामः समृध्यते। अथैनमपरः कामस्तृष्णाविध्यति बाणवत्॥
en: Vishvamitra said When one desire cherished by a person becomes satisfied, there originates immediately another whose satisfaction sought and which pierces him like an arrow.

sa: पापेन कर्मणा विप्रो धनं प्राप्य निरङ्कुशः। रागमोहान्वितः सोऽन्ते कलुषां गतिमश्नुते॥
en: That Brahmana of uncontrolled conduct, who acquires wealth by sinful deeds, overwhelmed by passion and stupefaction, attains at last to the goal of the sinful.

sa: अलर्क उवाच स्पृष्ट्वा त्वग्विविधान् स्पर्शी स्तानेव प्रतिगृध्यति। तस्मात् त्वचं पाटयिप्ये विविधैः कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Alarka said The skin, touching various objects of touch, hankers after them only. Hence, I shall tear off the skin with various arrows equipt with the feathers of the Kanka.

sa: संवर्त उवाच आविक्षित शुभा बुद्धिवर्ततां तव कर्मसु। याजनं हि ममाप्येव वर्तते हृदि पार्थिव॥ अभिधास्ये च ते राजन्नक्षयं द्रव्यमुत्तमम्। येन देवान् सगन्धर्वाशक्रं चाभिभविष्यसि॥
en: Samvarta said Listen, Son of Avikshit, excellent as is your inclination to perform this act, so too, O king, have I in my mind the ability to perform the sacrifice, I tell you, O king, that your good things will become imperishable, and that you shall lord it over Shakra and the Celestials with Gandharvas.

sa: घातिता पृथिवी येन सहया सनरद्विपा। राजानश्च महात्मानो नानाजनपदेश्वराः॥ आगम्य मम पुत्रार्थे सर्वे मृत्युवशं गताः। ये ते पितूंश्च दारांश्च प्राणांश्च मनसः प्रियान्॥ परित्यज्य गताः शूराः प्रेतराजनिवेशनम्। का नु तेषां गतिर्ब्रह्मन् मित्रार्थे ये हता मृधे॥ तथैव पुत्रपौत्राणां मम ये निहता युधि। दूयते मे मनोऽभीक्ष्णं घातयित्वा महाबलम्॥ भीष्मं शान्तनवं वृद्धं द्रोणं च द्विजसत्तमम्। मम पुत्रेण मूढेन पापेनाकृतबुद्धिना॥
en: Alas, the whole Earth has been devastated by him, with her horses, elephants and men. Many great kings, rulers of various kingdoms, came for helping my son and succumbed to death. Alas, leaving their beloved father and wives and their very life-breaths, all those heroes have become guests of the king of the dead. What end, O twice-born one, has been attained by those men who have killed, for the sake of their friend, in battle? What end also has attained by my sons and grandsons who have fallen in the battle? My heart is always pained at the thought of my having brought about the destruction of the powerful Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, and of Drona, that foremost of Brahmanas, through my foolish and sinful son who was an injurer of his friends.

sa: न हि मे वर्तते बुद्धिर्गन्तुं ब्रह्मन् बृहस्पतिम्। प्रत्याख्यातो हि तेनास्मि तथाऽनपकृते सति॥
en: As I have been repulsed by Brihaspati for no fault of mine, I have now no desire, O Brahmana, to go to him to scek his help in this sacrifice.

sa: बृहस्पति रुवाच अन्नमश्नन्ति यद् देवाः शरीरस्था नरेश्वर। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिर्मनस्तथा॥ ततस्तृप्तेषु राजेन्द्र तेषु भूतेषु पञ्चसु। मनःषष्ठेषु शुद्धात्मन् रेतः सम्पद्यते महत्॥
en: Brihaspati said The food that these gods, O king, who live in the body viz Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, Light and Mind, cat, pleases them. When those five elements become pleased, O monarch with Mind numbering as their sixth, their vital seed then becomes generated, O you of purified Soul.

sa: ततो धर्मसमायुक्तः स जीव: सुखमेधते। इहलोके परे चैव किं भूयः कथयामि ते॥
en: What else do you wish to hear? If gifted with virtue, individual soul enjoys happiness. What other subject, belonging to this or the other world shall I describe to you?

sa: पूर्णे च दशमे मासि पुत्रोऽस्य परमाद्भतुतः। रुक्मिण्यां सम्मतो यज्ञे शूरो वंशधरः प्रभो॥
en: His wife Rukmini conceived, and on the expiration of the tenth month a son was born of her, gifted with heroism and honoured by all for his highly wonderful accomplishments.

sa: ब्राह्मणानेव सेवस्व सत्कृत्य बहुमन्य च। एतेष्वेव त्विमे लोकाः कृत्स्ना इति निबोध तान्।।२६
en: Do you respect the Brahmanas and treat them with hospitality. Do you always serve them in this way. The universe rests on them. Do you understand them to be such.

sa: सुसमाहितचेतास्तु स ततोऽचिन्तयत् प्रभुः। स विचिन्त्य चिरं कालमलर्को द्विजसत्तम॥ नाध्यगच्छत् परं श्रेयो योगान्मतिमतां वरः। स एकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा निश्चलो योगमास्थितः॥
en: Gifted with power, he then, with mind well concentrated, began to reflect. Then, O best of twice-born ones, Alarka, that foremost of intelligent men, having thought for a long time, could not obtain anything better than Yoga. Setting his mind on one object he remained perfectly still, engaged in Yoga.

sa: न विस्मयस्ते नृपते यज्ञे कार्यः कथंचन। ऋषिकोटिसहस्राणि तपोभिर्ये दिवं गताः॥
en: You should not, o king, think highly of sacrifice. Million of Rishis have ascended to the celestial region with the help of only their penances.

sa: एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिर्धर्मराज्ञा महात्मना॥ अनुजज्ञे स कौरव्यमभिनन्द्य युधिष्ठिरम्।
en: Thus addressed by the great king Yudhishthira the just, that royal sage, viz., Dhritarashtra, blessed Yudhishthira and gave him permission.

sa: हा हा धिक् कुरुवीरस्य संनाहं काञ्चनं भुवि। आविद्धं हतस्येह मया पुत्रेण पश्यत॥
en: Alas, alas, the golden coat of mail of this foremost hero of Kuru's race, killed by me, his son, knowingly, is lying on the ground, cut off from his body.

sa: तस्मात् प्रयच्छ विप्रेषु छत्रोपानहमुत्तमम्। धर्मस्तेषु महान् भावी न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा॥
en: Do you, therefore, give away umbrellas and shoes to Brahmanas. I have no doubt that you will then acquire great religious merit by the deed.

sa: सोऽहमद्य गमिष्यामि गतिं पितृनिषेविताम्। न शक्नोप्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानमहं धारयितुं शुभे॥
en: I shall today follow in the track by which my father has gone. O blessed one, I cannot comfort myself.

sa: उपोष्य चापि किं तेन प्रदेय स्यानराधिप। धर्मेण च सुखार्थोल्लभेद् येन ब्रबीहि तम्॥
en: After having observed a fast, what should one give away, O king? O tell me, what those duties are by which one may succeed in acquiring objects leading to happiness.

sa: माता गरीयसी यच्च तेनैतां मन्यते जनः। ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पितृसमो मृते पितरि भारत॥
en: It is, therefore, that people regard the mother to deserve so much respect. After the demise of the father, O Bharata, the eldest brother should be considered as the father.

sa: लोकपालोऽसि लोकानां न लोकस्य विलोपकः।।१८ सोमेन दत्ता भार्या मे त्वया चापहृताद्य वै।
en: You may tell him further, You are a protector of the worlds, O Varuna, and not a destroyer. Why then have you abducted my wife bestowed upon me by Sona?

sa: तत्राश्रौषमहं सर्वमेतत् पुरुषसत्तम॥ यथा च नृपतिर्दग्धो देव्यौ ते चेति पाण्डव
en: There, O best of men, I heard all the details of how the king and the two qucens, O son of Pandu, had been burnt.

sa: प्रथमं ब्रह्मणः पुत्रं धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः। धर्मिणः पर्युपासन्ते फलं पक्वमिवाशयः॥
en: The righteous always adore them with love and affection as a hungry man's stomach longs for ripe and sweet fruits.

sa: यदृच्छयानुव्रजता मया राज्ञः कलेवरम्॥ तयोश्च देव्योरुभयोर्मया दृष्टानि भारत।
en: In course of my wanderings at will, I saw the bodies of that king and those two queens, O Bharata.

sa: ततस्तपोवने तस्मिन् समाजग्मुस्तपोधनाः॥ श्रुत्वा राज्ञस्तदा निष्ठां न त्वशोचन गतीश्च ते।
en: Many ascetics came to that asylum, having heard of the end of king Dhritarashtra. They did not at all grieve for that end of theirs.

sa: यत्रादहत् स भगवान् मातरं सव्यसाचिनः। कृत्वा यो ब्राह्मणच्छद्मा भिक्षार्थी समुपागतः॥ धिगग्नि धिक् च पार्थस्य विश्रुतां सत्यसंधताम्।
en: Alas, how could that deity burn the mother of Arjuna! Putting, on the guise of Brahmana, he had formerly come to Arjuna, for begging a favour! Fie on the deity of fire! Fie on the celebrated success of Partha's arrows.

sa: पूज्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन् मोदते स महेश्वरः। सुखं ददाति प्रीतात्मा भक्तानां भक्तवत्सलः॥
en: If his emblem is adored, Maheshvara becomes highly pleased with the adorer. Affectionate towards his devotees, he confers happiness upon them with a chcerful soui.

sa: जामदग्न्येन रामेण यः पुरा न पराजितः॥ दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महावीर्यः स हतोऽद्य शिखण्डिना।
en: He could not be defeated by even Rama of Jamadagni's race with his highly powerful celestial weapons; alas, that hero has been killed by Shikhandin.

sa: आगतोऽयं महाबाहो तस्य मन्दस्य पुत्रक॥ प्रसादमस्य बालस्य तस्मात् त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि।
en: This child of that wicked enemy of yours has now come to you, O mighty armed hero. You should, therefore, show mercy to this infant.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठरेणैवमुक्तो भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा। इमं श्राद्धविधिं कृत्स्नं वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by Yuthishthira, the son of Shantanu began of recite to him the following ritual, consistent with the ordinances, of the Shraddha.

sa: तमब्रवीत् पुनः कुष्णो मा त्वमत्र विचारय। अवश्यमेतत् कर्तव्यममोघं दर्शनं मम॥
en: Krishna, however, once more said to him, 'Do not scruple in this matter! This must be done! A sight of my form cannot be fruitless!

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचैनं कुशिकं च्यवनस्तदा। आगच्छेथाः सभार्यश्च त्वमिहेति नराधिप॥
en: Thus addressed by the king, Chyavana said to him – You shall, with your wife, return here tomorrow, O king.

sa: कर्णं स्मरेथाः सततं संग्रामेष्वपलायिनम्। अवकीर्णो हि समरे वीरो दुष्प्रज्ञया तदा॥
en: You should always bear in mind Karna who never retreated from battle. Through my folly that hero has been killed in the field of battle.

sa: स विवृद्धो महावीर्यो देवसेनापतिः प्रभुः। जघानामोघया शक्त्या दानवं तारकं गुहः॥
en: The commanderinchief of the celestial army grew up and became possessed of great energy and power. In time Guha killed Taraka, with his irresistible dart.

sa: चन्द्रमाः प्रददौ मेषमादित्यो रुचिरां प्रभाम्। गवां माता च गा देवी ददौ शतसहस्रशः॥
en: The Moon gave him a sheep, and the Sun gave him some dazzling rays of his. The mother of all kine, viz., Surabhi, gave him kine by hundreds and thousands.

sa: तथा त्वमपि कौन्तेय भक्त्या परमया युतः। गङ्गामभ्येहि सततं प्राप्स्यसे सिद्धिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Do you also, O son of Kunti, seek Ganga with great devotion for you will then, as the reward thereof, acquire great and excellent Success.

sa: ततो देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशद् दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः। रुद्रो धाता च विष्णुश्च यमः पूषार्यमा भगः॥ अंशो मित्रश्च साध्याश्च वासवो वसवोऽश्विनौ। आपो वायुर्नभश्चन्द्रो नक्षत्राणि ग्रहा रविः॥ पृथग्भूतानि चान्यानि यानि देवार्पणानि वै। आजग्मुस्तेऽद्भुतुं द्रष्टुं कुमारं ज्वलनात्मजम्॥
en: The thirtythree gods, the points of the compass together with their presiding deities, and Rudra, Dhatri, Vishnu, Yama, Pushan, Aryaman, Bhaga, Angsha Mitra, the Sadhyas, Vasava, the Vasus, the Ashvins, the Waters, the Wind, the Firmament, Chandramas and all the Constellations and the Planets and the Sun, and all the Richs and Samans and Yajushes in their embodied forms, came there to see that wonderful child who was the son of the god of Fire.

sa: आत्मवत् सर्वभूतेषु यश्चरेनियतः शुचिः। अमानी निरभीमानः सर्वतो मुक्त एव सः॥
en: He who treats all creatures as his ownself, who is restrained, pure, free froin vanity, and shorn of egoism, is considered as liberated from everything

sa: सुवर्णदाने च मया कथितास्ते गुणा विभो। तस्मात् सुवर्णे विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छ ददतां वर॥
en: I have also, O you of great power, described to you the merits of making gifts of gold. Do you, therefore, O foremost of all speakers, make gifts of gold.

sa: सायाह्ने स महीपालस्ततो गङ्गामुपेत्य च। चकार विधिवच्छौचं गान्धारी च यशस्विनी॥
en: As evening camne, the king, and the illustrious Gandhari, both descended into the stream of the Bhagirathi and duly performed their ablutions for purifying themselves.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु प्रतिप्रायाद् गृहं प्रति। तमागतपभिप्रेक्ष्य पिता वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥ मया त्वं यज्ञसंसिद्धौ नियुक्तो गुरुकर्मणि। कस्मात् प्रतिनिवृत्तोऽसि कच्चिन्न कुशलं तव॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the she ass Matanga returned home. Seeing him return. his father said I had engaged you in the difficult task of gathering the requisites of my intended sacrifice! Why have you returned without having accomplished your charge? Is it that you are not all right?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते यक्षवचनादुदतिष्ठन्त पाण्डवाः। क्षुत्पिपासे च सर्वेषां क्षणेन व्यपगच्छताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then, at the words of the Yaksha the Pandavas rose up and their hunger and thirst forsook them in a short time.

sa: यदा द्रष्टा पततः स्यन्दनेभ्यो महागजेभ्योऽश्वगतान् सुयोधनान्। शरैर्हतान् पातितांश्चैव रङ्गे तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
en: When he sees excellent warriors falling dead from their chariots and huge elephants struck by my arrows in the field then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

sa: दिष्ट्या त्वां पार्थ पश्यामि स्वागतं ते धनंजय। लोहिताक्ष महाबाहो नागराजकरोपम॥
en: By good luck I have seen you, O Partha, Welcome, O Dhananjaya, O you with red eyes and mighty arms resembling the trunk of elephants.

sa: समावृता दिशो दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवेन शितैः शरैः। धनंजयसखाऽऽत्मानं दर्शयामास वै तदा॥
en: Seeing all directions covered with a net work of sharp arrows shot by the Pandavas, that friend of Dhananjaya (the Gandharva king) appeared before him,

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच चित्रसेनं समागम्य प्रहसनर्जुनस्तदा। इदं वचनकक्लीबमब्रवीत् परवीरहा॥
en: Duryodhana said : That slayer of hostile army, Arjuna, then came to Chitrasena and he smilingly spoke these manly words.

sa: दिष्ट्या कुशलिन: सर्वे सह दामोदरेण ते। दिष्ट्या सहायवन्तश्चदिष्ट्या धर्मे च ते रताः॥
en: It is lucky that they all along with Damodara are doing well; it is lucky that have secured aid and it is lucky that they are intent on acting virtuously.

sa: कृत्वा तुभ्यं नमो विप्राः स्वकर्मविजितां गतिम्। गच्छन्ति सह पत्नीभिः सुतैरपि च शाश्वतीम्॥
en: The Brahmanas, having bowed down to you, go away along with their wives and sons, to the eternal region, which has been won by the merit of their own deeds.

sa: तत्र राजा शूरान् बुद्धिमतो नरान्। प्रसमीक्ष्य महाबाहुश्चक्रे सेनापतींस्तदा॥
en: The king Duryodhana, of long arms selecting men who were wise and also heroes, made them leaders of his army.

sa: धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे त्वं महाबलः हितेषु वर्तसे नित्यं सफलं जन्म चाद्य मे॥
en: "I am blessed, for I have been favoured by you. When you who possess the greatest prowess are eager to look after my welfare, my life has borne fruit today.

sa: शैशुपालिं ततो गत्वा विजिग्ये सूतनन्दनः॥ पार्श्वस्थांश्चापि नृपतीन् वशे चक्रे महाबलः।
en: Then going to the son of Shishupala, the Suta's son defeated him and that greatly powerful hero then brought under subjection all the neighbouring chiefs.

sa: न च तौ वक्ष्यतोऽधर्ममिति मे नैष्ठिकी मतिः। नापि युक्तं च कौन्तेय निवर्तितुमयुध्यतः॥
en: I firmly adhere to the opinion that they will not say what is unrighteous, not is it proper, O son of Kunti, that we should turn back without enjoying war."

sa: ते वै धन्या यैः कृतं ज्ञातिकार्य ते वै पुत्राः सुहृदो बान्धवाश्च। र्यतः कुरूणां नियतो वैभव: स्यात्॥
en: Blessed are they who promote the interests of their cousins. They are the sons, friends and well-wishers indeed (of the Kurus) who, in order that prosperity may ever attend the Kurus, would sacrifice their life which is of small value.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे तथेत्यूचुर्नराधिपम्। संदिदेश ततो राजा व्यापारस्थान् यथाक्रमम्॥ हलस्य करणे चापि व्यादिष्टाः सर्वशिल्पिनः। यथोक्तं च नृपश्रेष्ठ कृतं सर्वं यथाक्रमम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed, they all said to the king, "So be it.” Then the king one by one appointed persons to the respective posts in the sacrifice). He desired the artizans to construct the plough. O foremost of kings, all that was commanded by the king was gradually executed.

sa: ते यात्वानुसृतैर्मार्ग: स्वनैः शुचिजलान्वितैः। ददृशुः काम्यकं पुण्यमाश्रमं तापसायुतम्॥
en: Proceeding along the road furnished with excellent corn and clear water they at last saw the sacred hermitage of Kamyaka.

sa: कथं हि नीचा इव दौष्कुलेया निर्धर्मार्थं कर्म कुर्युश्च पार्थाः। सोऽहं प्रसाद्य प्रणतो वासुदेवं पञ्चालानामधिपं चैव वृद्धम्॥
en: Why should the sons of Pritha do an wicked act like mean people and those born in low families? Therefore having approached you, do I bow to the son of Vasudeva and the aged lord of the people of Panchala.

sa: रथायुतानि चत्वारि हयाः पञ्चगुणास्तथा। पत्तिसैन्यं दशगुणं गजानामयुतानि षट्॥
en: Forty thousand chariots, five times that number of horses, ten times that number of foot soldiers, and sixty thousand elephants.

sa: अकुर्वतश्चेत् पुरुषस्य संजय सिद्ध्येत् संकल्पो मनसा ये यमिच्छेत्। दन्यत्र युद्धाद् बहु यल्लघीयः॥
en: If what a man desires in his heart is fulfilled, O Sanjaya, without doing anything then he will not do anything even if that be very much easier than war.

sa: क्षुद् धर्मसंज्ञा प्रणुदत्यादत्ते धैर्यमेव च। रसानुसारिणी जिह्वा कर्षत्येव रसान् प्रति॥
en: The pangs of hunger drive away all sense of virtue and deprive people of patience. The gongues, that always love, delicacies, attract men towards them.

sa: प्राप्तैश्वर्यो धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य राजा लालप्यते संजय कस्य हेतोः। प्रगृह्य दुर्बुद्धिमनार्जवे रतं पुत्रं मन्दं मूढममन्त्रिणं तु॥
en: Having got wealth why does the king Dhritarashtra now grieve for his lot O Sanjaya? Simply because he had accepted the secret advice to his dull-headed son of vicious soul and addicted to dishonest ways.

sa: न सुखे सुखकामास्ते देवदेवाः सनातनाः। न कल्पपरिवर्तेषु परिवर्तन्ति ते तथा॥
en: Those everlasting gods of the gods do not desire happiness for happiness sake, nor do they undergo any change at the change of a Kalpa.

sa: एष नो विजये मूलमेष तात विपर्यये। अत्र प्राणाश्च राज्यं च भावाभावौ सुखासुखे॥
en: He, my dear brothers, in the root of our victory or our defeat and on him depend our lives, our kingdom, our success, our want, our happiness and our misery.

sa: तथा करिष्ये त्वत्प्रीत्येत्येवमुक्त्वा सुयोधनम्॥ दुर्वासा अपि विप्रेन्द्रो यथागतमगात् ततः। कृतार्थमपि चात्मानं तदा मेने सुयोधनः॥
en: He (Rishi) replied to the Duryodhana “I shall do it for your satisfaction.” Having said this, that great Brahmana went in the way he came. Duryodhana then considered that all his desires had been fulfilled.

sa: अल्पकालं जीवितं यन्मनुष्ये महास्रावं नित्यदुःखं चलं च। भूयश्च तद् यशसो नानुरूपं तस्मात् पापं पाण्डव मा कृथास्त्वम्॥
en: Şince a man's life lasts but for a short time and is ever subject to sufferings and is unstable and since again it is not comparable to fame, therefore should you not do, O son of Pandu, a sinful art.

sa: गान्धार्या धृतराष्ट्रेण समक्षं मम भारत। एतत् ते कथितं राजन् यद् वृत्तं कुरुसंसदि।॥
en: And by Gandhari and by Dhritarashtra in my presence, O Bharata, in fact every thing that took place in the assembly of the Kurus, I have told you, O king.

sa: अवमत्यास्य तद् वाक्यमाक्षिप्य च सुमध्यमा। मैवमित्यब्रवीत् कृष्णा लज्जस्वेति च सैन्धव॥
en: Disregarding his words and remonstrating with him that youthful Krishna said to the king of Saindhava, “Do not speak this again. Are you not ashamed?”

sa: यादवानां कुलकरो बलवान् वीर्यसम्मतः। अवमेने स तु क्षत्रं दर्पपूर्णः सुमन्दधीः॥
en: The ancestor of the Yadavas, endued with strength and prowess as he was, being full of pride and vanity and wicked intelligence, insulted the Kshatriyas.

sa: पुर्यवीयांश्च ततो योऽस्माकं वंशवर्धनः। शर्मिष्ठया सम्प्रसूतो दुहित्रा वृषपर्वणः॥
en: Younger than he was Puru and he was our ancestor; he was brought forth by Sharmishtha, the daughter of Vrishaparvan.

sa: भविष्यति जयो देवाः शक्रस्य मम तेजसा। अदृश्यश्च प्रवेक्ष्यामि वज्रे ह्यस्यायुधोत्तमे॥
en: O gods, through my influence, victory will be on the side of Shakra. Being invisible shall I enter the thunder bolt-that excellent weapons of his.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्ते तु गान्धार्या धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। दुर्योधनमुवाचेदं राजमध्ये जनाधिप॥
en: Vasudeva said Words like these having been spoken by Gandhari that lord of men, Dhritarashtra in the midst of the kings, O lord of men.

sa: गाण्डीवमुक्तांश्च महाशरौघान् पतंगसङ्घानिव शीघ्रवेगान्। यदा द्रष्टास्यर्जुनं वीर्यशालिनं तदा स्वबुद्धिं प्रतिनिन्दितासि॥
en: When you shall see the collection of dreadful shafts discharged by Arjuna from Gandiva, quick-coursing and like locusts you shall repent for your own folly.

sa: जग्राह तामुत्तरवस्त्रदेशे जयद्रथस्तं समवाक्षिपत् सा। तया समाक्षिप्ततनुः स पाप: पपात शाखीव निकृत्तमूलः॥
en: Jayadratha caught hold of her by her upper garment but she pushed him with great force; pushed by her, that sinful wretch fell down on earth like an uprooted tree.

sa: चित्रकार इवालेख्यं कृत्वा स्थापितवानसि। प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा यथा संहरते तथा॥
en: Brought into being as a painter does a picture. Do not act like the lord of creatures, who having created living beings again destroys them.

sa: शक्रं जहीति चाप्युक्तो जगाम त्रिदिवं ततः। ततो युद्धं समभवद् वृत्रवासवयोर्महत्॥
en: And the powerful one, being told to slay Shakara, went to the third heaven. And then there was a fierce battle between Vritra and Vasava.

sa: तदध्वानः पितरो ये च पूर्वे पितामहा ये च तेभ्यः परेऽन्ये। र्नान्यं ततो नास्तिकोऽस्मीति मन्ये॥
en: That path has been followed by our fathers and grandfathers and also by others and all those who are wise adopt the same path. For this I do not consider that they were not orthodox.

sa: नकुलस्तस्य नागस्य समीपपरिवर्तिनः। सविषाणं भुजं मूले खड्न निरकृन्तत॥
en: But he with his sword cut off from his head both trunk and tusks when the elephant came near him.

sa: भीमस्त्वापततो राज्ञः कोटिकास्यस्य सङ्गरे। सूतस्य नुदतो वाहान् क्षुरेणापाहरच्छिरः॥
en: Beholding the prince Kotikasya rush to the battle, Bhima, with a horse shoe shaft, sundered the head of his charioteer.

sa: सुदुष्करस्तत्र शमो हि नूनं प्रदर्शितः संजय पाण्डवेन। यस्मिन् गृद्धो धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रः कस्मादेषां कलहो नावमूछेत्॥
en: Peace, of a rare sort, indeed, has been shown, O Sanjaya, by the son of Pandu, when Dhritarashtra with his sons is avaricious; why should the quarrel between these two parties rise to good proportions.

sa: शक्र उवाच पश्चाद् धर्मं चरिष्यामि पावनार्थं सुदुश्चरम्। शत्रुरेष महावीर्यो वज्रेण निहतो मया।॥
en: Shakra said For the purification of my soul I shall thereafter precise some severe penance. He was my enemy, possessed of great strength and has been killed by my thunderbolt.
