sa: विमुखं हतसूतं तं भीमः प्रहरतां वरः। जघान तलयुक्तेन प्रासेनाभ्येत्य पाण्डवः॥
en: The Pandava Bhima, the foremost of heroes, slew, with a bearded arrow, that prince who had lost his chariot and was flying from the battle-field.

sa: मवेक्ष्य त्वं संजय स्वं च कर्म। निशम्याथो पाण्डवानां च कर्म प्रशंस वा निन्द वा या मतिस्ते॥
en: Having considered the principle on which the four divisions were originally based and the duties of each, O Sanjaya and having fully ascertained the proposed line of action of the Pandavas, praise or blame it, as you may think fit.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तं राजा कृष्यमाणो जयद्रथः। प्रोवाच पुरुषव्याघ्र भीममहावशोभिनम्॥
en: Being thus treated the king Jayadratha said to that best of men, Bhima, who beautifies the battle-field "So be it."

sa: पूर्वा दिग् लोहिताकारा शस्त्रवर्णा च दक्षिणा। आमपात्रप्रतीकाशा पश्चिमा मधुसूदन। उत्तरा शङ्खवर्णाभा दिशां वर्णा उदाहृताः॥
en: The eastern direction looks red and the southern is the colour of weapons while the western looks the earth, O slayer of Madhu. North looks like the conch. These are the colours of all directions.

sa: बलिर्ददौ प्रसन्नात्मा विप्रायामिततेजसे। ततो दिव्याद्भुततमं रूपं विक्रमतो हरेः॥
en: Delightedly Bali gave what that highly powerful Vipra wanted. Thereupon while measuring the space Hari assumed a highly wonderful form.

sa: यं देवं विदुषो गान्ति तस्य कर्माणि सैन्धव। यामाहुरजितं कृष्णं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्॥
en: These are his achievement, O Saindhava, whom the wise thus describe. They call him the unconquerable Krishna, with conch, discus and club in his hands.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कृतमित्यब्रवीच्छल्यः किमन्यत् क्रियतामिति। कृतमित्येव गान्धारिः प्रत्युवाच पुनः पुनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Said Shalya “It is done. What else do you desire of me?" and the son of Gandhari kept on repeating, “It is done."

sa: तां जहार बलाद् राजा मूढबुद्धिर्जयद्रथः। तस्याः संहरणात् पापः शिरसः केशपातनम्॥ पराजयं च संग्रामे ससहायः समाप्तवान्। प्रत्याहृता तथास्माभिर्हत्वा तत् सैन्धवं बलम्॥
en: The foolish king Jayadratha took her away by force; on account of this violence on her that sinful man has got his hair shaved off and has met with defeat in battle along with his soldiers. True it is, that we have rescued her after slaying the army of Saindhava.

sa: स ताः सभाः समासाद्य पूज्यमानो यथाऽमरः। दुर्योधनस्य सचिवैर्देशे देशे समन्ततः॥
en: Being welcomed and honoured by the agents of Duryodhana, as he arrived at these palaces in different countries, with the worship due to the gods.

sa: वधाद् बन्धाद् भयाद् वापि लोभाद् वापि जनार्दन। अनृतं नोत्सहे कर्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: From a fear of being slain, from a fear of being captured or from covetousness even, O Janardana, I do not dare behave treacherously to the intelligent son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: खरो धनुषि विक्रान्तो ब्रह्मविट् पिशिताशनः। सिद्धविघ्नकरी चापि रौद्री शूर्पणाखा तथा॥
en: Khara was proficient in archery, inimical towards Brahmanas and used to eat flesh; Shurpanakha used always to put impediments in the performance of ascetic observances.

sa: स हि मे जातकर्मादि कारयामास माधव। शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना पुत्रप्रीत्या जनार्दन॥
en: He had the necessary ceremonies, during childhood, enjoined by the holy books, performed, O Madhava, in a suitable manner cut of paternal love, O Janardana.

sa: जातामर्षास्ततस्ते तु तपसे धृतनिश्चयाः। ब्रह्माणं तोषयामासुघरिण तपसा तदा॥
en: Possessed by jealousy they made up their mind to perform devout penances; and they pleased Brahma with severest ascetic penances.

sa: तव पूर्वाभिगमनात् पूर्वं चाप्यस्य दर्शनात्। साहाय्यमुभयोरेव करिष्यामि सुयोधन॥
en: O Suyodhana, yourself having come first and he having been seen by me first, I shall help both of you.

sa: शल्य उवाच एवं वदत्यङ्गिरसां वरिष्ठे बृहस्पतौ लोकपालः कुबेरः। वैवस्वतश्चैव यमः पुराणो देवश्च सोमो वरुणचाजगाम॥
en: Shalya said While Brihaspati, that best among the race of Angira, was yet speaking, Kubera, the ruler of the world and Yama, the son of Vivasvata and the aged god Soma and Varuna came there.

sa: चरितब्रह्मचर्यास्ते कृतदाराश्च पार्थिव। यदा तदा दशरथः प्रीतिमानभवत् सुखी॥
en: When after having observed the Brahmacharya vows, they got they got married. Dasharatha, O king, became (very) pleased and happy.

sa: पृथिव्यां राजराजोऽस्मि चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता। यस्तेऽभिलषित: कामो ब्रूहि कल्याणि मा चिरम्॥
en: I am, in this world, the king of all kings and the guardian of the four orders, O fortunate one, express your desire without delay".

sa: ददर्श चित्रकूटस्थं स रामं सहलक्ष्मणम्। तापसानामलंकारं धारयन्तं धनुर्धरम्॥
en: (And he) found Rama together with Lakshmana in the mountain) Chitrakuta bow in hand and wearing the garb of ascetics.

sa: त्रिकूटं समतिक्रम्य कालपर्वतमेव च। ददर्श मकरावासं गम्भीरोदं महोदधिम्॥
en: Crossing the mountains Trikuta and Kala he beheld the mighty ocean of deep waters, the abode of the Makaras (alligators).

sa: प्रत्यक्षं ते महाबाहो यथा पार्थेन धीमता। विराटनगरे पूर्वं सर्व स्म युधि निर्जिताः॥
en: You are an witness, O you of long arms, how before this in the city of Virata, all of us were vanquished in battle by the wise son of Pritha.

sa: ते व्यतीत्य महाध्वानं क्षिप्रं श्येना इवाशुगाः। उच्चैर्जग्मुरुपल्पव्यं शार्ङ्गधन्वानमावहन्॥
en: Having traversed a long way speedily like quick-coursing hawks the horses reached Upaplavya, bearing the wielders of the Shranga bow.

sa: एष जेष्यति संग्रामे कुरून् सर्वान् समागतान्। भीमसेनद्वितीयश्च लोकमुद्वर्तयिष्यति॥
en: He will conquer in fight all the Kurus assembled together and with Bhimasena as his second will grind his enemies.

sa: एतच्चैव करिष्यामो यत्नश्च क्रियतामिह। प्रस्थापयाम मित्रेभ्यो बलान्युद्योजयन्तु नः॥
en: We shall do this; let us make preparations here and send word to our friends to collect armies for us.

sa: अधर्म्यमयशस्यं च शात्रवाणां प्रयाचनम्। हृद्गतस्तस्य य: कामस्तं कुरुध्वमतन्द्रिताः॥
en: It is both impious and shameful to beg from enemies; do speedily, therefore that which is his (Yudhishthira's) heart-felt desire.

sa: मा च तेऽस्तु भयं भीरु रावणाल्लोकगहितात्। नलकूबरशापेन रक्षिता ह्यसि नन्दिनि॥
en: O timid lady, you have no fear from Ravana who is cursed by all the world, (because) O daughter, you are protected by Nalakubera's imprecation.

sa: चैषां भविष्यति पराभवः। प्रकृति ते भजिष्यन्ति नष्टप्रकृतयो मयि॥
en: As great time rolls on, they will meet with defeat. Your subjects no longer yours will now adhere to me.

sa: पादयोः पातयिष्यामि कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः। अथ ते न व्यवस्यन्ति प्रणिपाताय धीमतः॥
en: And make them fall at the fect of the noble son of Kunti. If they refuse to fall at the feet of the wise (Yudhishthira).

sa: अपि राज्यमयोध्यायां कारयिष्याम्यहं पुनः। निहत्य समरे शत्रूनाहत्य जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: Having killed my enemy in battle and delivered the daughter of Janaka, will you enable me to reign at Ayodhya?

sa: ततः पर्वतशृङ्गाभं घोररूपं भयावहम्। पक्षिणं दृष्टवन्तः स्म वैनतेयमिवापरम्॥
en: Then we beheld an awe-inspiring and a terrible-looking bird huge as mountain-peak and looking like another son of Vinata (Garuda).

sa: यावद् बलं मे पुत्रेषु पश्यतस्तेजनार्दन। प्रत्यक्षं ते न ते किंचितं परोक्षं शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: “The influence I wield over my sons you have seen, O Janardana; you have been a saw witness to that; nothing has happened behind your back, O chastiser of foes.

sa: तत्र सीता मया दृष्टा रावणान्तःपुरे सती। उपवासतप:शीला भर्तृदर्शनलालसा॥
en: I (then) discovered the chaste Sita in the । Ravana's household observing austerities and fasts, eager to behold her husband,

sa: उत्पतन्तः पतन्तश्च प्लवमानाश्च वानराः। उद्धन्वन्तोऽपरे रेणून् समाजग्मुः समन्ततः॥
en: And as the monkeys flocked in from all sides, some fell down, some leaped about and some scattered the dust.

sa: एकं विषरसो हन्ति शस्त्रेणैकश्च बध्यते। सराष्ट्र सप्रजं हन्ति राजानं मन्त्रविप्लवः॥
en: Poison kills but one and also one is slain by a weapon, while disagreement between ministers destroys a king with the kingdom and the subjects.

sa: हि मे विक्रमे तुल्यः पुमानस्तीह कश्चन। हनिष्यामि रणे भागं यन्मे दास्यसि पाण्डवा॥
en: There is no man in this world who is equal to me in prowess. I shall slay in battle that portion of your enemy you will allot to my share,

sa: सिंहो नागानिव क्रुद्धो गमयेद् यमसादनम्। न त्वयं निन्दितं कर्म कुर्यात् पापं कथंचन॥
en: And rendered angry, will send them to the abode of Yama like a lion routing a heard of elephants; but this mighty blamable act of wickedness will never be perpetrated.

sa: भक्तं च भजमानं च तवास्मीति च वादिनम्। त्रीनेतांश्छरणं प्राप्तान् विषमेऽपि न संत्यजेत्॥
en: The grant of a boon, of a kingdom and the begetting of a son, O son of Bharata, these three are equaled by the release of foe from difficulty alone.

sa: तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे घोरे रुधिरकर्दमे। धूम्राक्षः कपिसैन्यं तद् द्रावयामास पत्रिभः॥
en: (And) in that battle which raged hot and furious, making the field muddy with blood, Dhumraksha began to oppress the monkeyarmy with (showers of) arrows.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा व्यथनं कर्म कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः॥ उदक्रोशन् परित्रस्तास्तारप्रभृतयस्तदा।
en: Seeing that terrible act of the Rakshasa Kumbhakarna, Tara and others were greatly alarıned and sent forth a loud wai).

sa: आचष्ट तमभिप्रायं केशवाय महात्मने। धृतराष्ट्रं ततश्चैव विदुरं चान्वभाषत॥
en: Communicated that intention (of those Kurus) to the great should Keshava and then to Dhritarashtra and then to Vidura also.

sa: ततो हर्यश्वयुक्तेन रथेनादित्यवर्चसा। उपतस्थे रणे रामं मातलिः शक्रसारथिः॥
en: Then, Matali, the charioteer of Shakra, came to Rama with a car, of sun-like splendour and yoked with tawny-coloured horses.

sa: सभायामुत्थित क्रुद्धं प्रस्थितं भ्रातृभिः सह। दुर्योधनमभिप्रेक्ष्य भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing Duryodhana rise up in that council and go away accompanied by his brothers, Bhishma the son of Shantanu said.

sa: भ्रातुरेतद् वचः श्रुत्वा धार्तराष्ट्रः सुयोधनः। क्रुद्धः प्रातिष्ठतोत्थाय महानाग इव श्वसन्॥
en: Suyodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra, hearing those words of his brother was very angry and got up from his seat breathing like a huge serpent.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवति दाशार्हे दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। दुःशासन इदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् कुरुसंसदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said The scion of the Dasharha race having thus spoken to the wrathful Duryodhana, Dushasana said these words in the assembly of the Kurus.

sa: ततोऽभिगम्य तीर्थानि सर्वाण्येवाश्रमांस्तथा। आजगाम पितुर्वेश्म सावित्री सह मन्त्रिभिः॥
en: Savitri, after visiting all the Tirthas and the hermitages, came to the abode of her father together with the ministers.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा समुत्पत्य नारदस्त्रिदिवं गतः। राजापि दुहितुः सज्जं वैवाहिकमकारयत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Saying this, Narada, soaring upwards, returned to heaven. And the king too began to ..jake preparations for the marriage of his daughter.

sa: अनुबन्धं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य विपाकं चैव कर्मणाम्। उत्थानमात्मनश्चैव धीरः कुर्वीत वा न वा॥
en: A wise man dose or dose not do an act after reflecting on the reasons of act and its results if done, as also the energy of his own self.

sa: तथैव प्रियवादेन नैपुणेन शमेन च। रहाचैवोपचारेण भर्तारं पर्यतोषयत्॥
en: Similarly, by agreeable words, by skillfulness, by sweet disposition and by ministering to him in private she delighted her husband.

sa: वैदूर्याङ्कुरकल्पानि मृदूनि हरितानि च। चरन्तीश्लक्ष्णशष्पाणि तिक्तानि मधुराणि च॥
en: Subsisting on sweet and green grass resembling the blades of the Vaidurya gem and which were both sweet and bitter,

sa: ततः सर्वान् द्विजान् वृद्धान् श्व श्वशुरमेव च। अभिवाद्यानुपूर्येण प्राञ्जलिर्नियता स्थिता॥
en: She then bowed down to all the aged Brahmanas, her father-in-law and mother-inlaw, one after the other and stood humbly before them with joined hands.

sa: एष विग्रहवान् धर्म एष वीर्यवतां वरः। एष बुद्ध्याधिको लोके तपसां च परायणम्॥
en: He is in fact the embodiment of Virtue and the foremost of the powerful. He is of superior intelligence in this world and intent on the performance of ascetic rites.

sa: अजैकपादहिर्बुध्यै रक्ष्यते धनदेन च। एवं न शक्यते लब्धुमलब्धव्यं द्विजर्षभ। ऋते च धनमश्वानां नावाप्तिर्विद्यते तव।॥
en: That wealth is guarded by the Ajaikapada and the Ahibrudhnyas as also by the giver of wealth (Kubera): such being the case, O best among the twice-born, it is very difficult to get that wealth.

sa: यम उवाच न च स्वधर्मात् परिहास्यते नृपः। कृतेन कामेन मया नृपात्मजे निवर्तगच्छस्व न ते श्रमो भवेत्॥
en: Yama said: That monarch will be soon restored to his kingdom and be ever firm in his duties Princess, I have now gratified your wish. Do not proceed further; go back; do not allow yourself to be any more weary.

sa: एतयोपमया धीरः संनमेत बलीयसे। इन्द्राय स प्रणमते नमते यो बलीयसे॥
en: Following this example, a wise man should bend to one stronger than himself and he who bends before the stronger bows down to Indra himself.

sa: सम्पन्नतरमेवान्नं दरिद्रा भुञ्जते सदा। क्षुत् स्वादुतां जनयति सा चाढ्येषु सुदुर्लभा॥
en: The poor however ever take the most delicious food; for hunger imparts sweetness of taste to it; it (hunger) is ever rare among the opulent.

sa: तमुवाचाथ सावित्री रजनी व्यवगाहते। वस्ते सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्यास्यामि नृपात्मज॥
en: Thereupon Savitri replied to him "prince, the night is deepening tomorrow, I will disciose to you faithfully all that occurred.

sa: यदि नोत्सहसे गन्तुं सरुजं त्वां हि लक्षये। न च ज्ञास्यसि पन्थानं तमसा संवृते वने॥
en: If you do not venture to go. (I will do all this). I see you are unwell. You will not be able to discern the paths as a dense darkness is hanging over these woods.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रज्ञावृद्धो महाद्युतिः। सम्पूज्यैनं यथाकालं भीष्मो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of his, Bhishma, of great luster and old in wisdom, did him due honours and spoke these words to him as suited the occasion.

sa: सत्यवानुवाच पित्राहमभ्यनुज्ञातः सावित्री सहितो गतः। अथ मेऽभूच्छिरोदुःखं वने काष्ठानि भिन्दतः॥
en: Satyavana said: Taking leave of my father I went out with Savitri. While cutting down the woods in the forest my head began to ache.

sa: सुप्तश्चाहं वेदनया चिरमित्युपलक्षये। तावत् कालं न च मया सुप्तपूर्वं कदाचन॥
en: Afflicted with the pain I slept a long while. Thus far only do I remember. Never before did I sleep for so long a time.

sa: भुक्तं मे तिष्ठ तावत् त्वमित्युक्त्वा भगवान् ययौ। विश्वामित्रस्ततो राजन् स्थितं एव महाद्युतिः॥
en: I have taken my food; you stay here for the present" saying this the divinely prosperous one went away and then did Vishvamitra, of great effulgence, O king, stand there.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दुर्योधनस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा निःश्वसन् भृकुटीमुखः। राधेयमभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य जहास स्वनवत् तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Duryodhana, having heard all this, breathing herd with his eye-brows contracted and gazing on the son of Radica, laughed aloud at that time.

sa: स त्वमप्येनमाराध्य सूनृताभिः पुनः पुनः। अभ्यर्थयेथा देवेशममोघार्थं पुरन्दरम्॥
en: Worshipping again and again with agreeable and truthful speeches the lord of the celestials, Purandara, the possessor of infallible weapons.

sa: केशिन्युवाच इहैवावां प्रतीक्षाव उपस्थाने विरोचन। सुधन्वा प्रातरागन्ता पश्येयं वां समागतौ॥
en: Keshini said Even in this very Pavilion shall we wait, O Virochana. Sudhanvan will come in the morning to-morrow; I shall both of you together.

sa: तमब्रवीत् कुन्तिभोजः प्रीतियुक्तमिदं वचः। एवमस्तु परं चेति पुनश्चैनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: (Then) Kuntibhoja gladly said these words "be it so and even more than this.” And he told him again thus.

sa: असह्यं सर्वभूतानां ममापि विपुलं बलम्। मयापि सुमहत् कर्म कृतं दैतेयविग्रहे॥
en: My great strength too is unendurable by all creature and by me too have been done great deeds in the war the sons of Diti.

sa: ततस्ते सुमुखं गृह्य सर्व एव महौजसः। ददृशुः शक्रमासीनं देवराजं महाद्युतिम्॥
en: Then all of them, endued with great energy taking Sumukha along with them, proceeded and saw the king of gods, Shakra of great effulgence seated.

sa: सा त्वं दर्पं परित्यज्य दम्भं मानं च भाविनि। आराध्य वरदं विप्रं श्रेयसा योक्ष्यसे पृथे॥
en: So, O damsel, O Pritha, giving up your pride, haughtiness and the sense of your high position, you will minister to this Brahmana capable of bestowing boons. In that case you will surely be blessed.

sa: तवाभिसंधिः सुभगे सूर्यात् पुत्रो भवेदिति। वीर्येणाप्रतिमो लोके कवची कुण्डलीति च॥
en: O fortunate damsel, your desire is to have from Surya a son, of unrivalled prowess in the world and furnished with a coat-of-mail and ear-rings.

sa: यस्याः क्षीरस्य धाराया निपतन्त्या महीतले। ह्रदः कृतः क्षीरनिधिः पवित्रं परमुच्यते॥
en: One stream, even of whose milk, having fallen on the face of the earth made a lake which is called the excellent and holy sea-milk.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा वै शापपरित्रस्ता बहु चिन्तयती हृदा। मोहेनाभिपरीताङ्गी स्मयमाना पुनः पुनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Afraid of (his) curse she reflected much in her mind. Her limbs were quite paralysed and she was repeatedly at a loss as to how to act.

sa: भवनं वारुणं पश्य यदेतत् सर्वकाञ्चनम्। यत् प्राप्य सुरतां प्राप्ताः सुराः सुरपतेः सखे॥
en: Behold this mansion of Varuna which is inade entirely of gold and attaining to which the gods have obtained their god-ship ( you friend of the lord of the gods.

sa: धन्यस्ते पुत्र जनको देवो भानुर्विभावसुः। यस्त्वां द्रक्ष्यति दिव्येन चक्षुषा वाहिनीगतम्॥
en: Blessed is indeed your divine father, Bhanu, having effulgence for his wealth, who by means of his celestials sight, beholds you going down the stream.

sa: श्रीमङ्गलात् प्रभवति प्रागल्भ्यात् सम्प्रवर्धते। दाक्ष्यात् तु कुरुते मूलं संयमात् प्रतितिष्ठति।॥
en: Prosperity has for its source good deeds; it increases owing to activity and takes root owing to skill and continues its existence owing to self-control.

sa: प्रतिजग्राह तं राधा विधिवद् दिव्यरूपिणम्। पुत्रं कमलगर्भामं देवगर्भं श्रिया वृतम्॥
en: Thereupon, Radha duly adopted that body of celestials appearance and birth, endued with the splendour of the filaments of lotuses and possessed of excellent grace.

sa: भूयिष्ठेन तु राजानः श्रियं भुक्त्वाऽऽयुषः क्षये। तरुणाः प्रतिपद्यन्ते भोक्तुं सुकृतदुष्कृते॥
en: The kings, enjoying great prosperity up to the end of their lives, are born anew to enjoy the effects of their good and bad deeds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जामदग्न्य वचः श्रुत्वा कण्वोऽपि भगवानृषिः। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् कुरुसंसदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of the son of Jamadagni, the illustrious Rishi Kanva addressed these words to Duryodhana in the assembly of the Kurus.

sa: हयांश्च नागांश्च रथांस्च शीघ्रं पदातिसङ्घांश्च ततः प्रवीरान्। प्रस्थापयामास सुतस्य हेतोविचित्रशस्त्राभरणोपपन्नान्॥
en: Saying this, the king Virata soon dispatched for his son, horses, elephants, cars, and a large number of infantry, decked with various dresses and ornaments.

sa: तस्माद् विनिमयं कृत्वा कुण्डले वर्म चोत्तमम्। हरस्व शक्र कामं मे न दद्यामहमन्यथा॥
en: Therefore, O Shakra, take my ear-rings and excellent armour in exchange (for boons to be conferred on me by you). Else I will in no way, give (them to you).

sa: शक्र उवाच विदितोऽहं रवेः पूर्वमायानेव तवान्तिकम्। तेन ते सर्वमाख्यातमेवमेतन्न संशयः॥
en: Shakra said: Before I came to you, Ravi (the sun) was aware of my intentions. There is no doubt that he has told you all.

sa: स गत्वा विषमं घोरं पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्। मार्गमाणोऽन्वगच्छत् तौ तापसौ वनमाश्रितौ॥
en: He. going to the rightful and unapproachable Gandhamadana, hunted for the two devotees and at last met them who had taken refuge in the wilderness.

sa: चरन्तं हसरूपेण महर्षिं संशितव्रतम्। साध्या देवा महाप्राज्ञं पर्यपृच्छन्त वै पुरा॥
en: While the great Rishi of rigid vows was wandering as a mendicant, the deities called Saddhyas, in days of old, asked him of great wisdom.

sa: अतिवादं न प्रवदेन वादयेद् योऽनाहतः प्रतिहन्यान्न घातयेत्। हन्तुं च यो नेच्छति पापकं वै तस्मै देवाः स्पृहयन्त्यागताय॥
en: The gods court the company of one who when reviled does not return nori induces others to return and who when struck does not strike in return or make others strike and who does not wish to injure his assailant.

sa: नैषां शस्त्रप्रहारोऽस्ति पदं नेहास्ति कस्यचित्। भूतं महदिदं मन्ये भ्रातरो येन मे हताः॥
en: There are no strokes of weapons on their bodies nor are there any foot prints of any body. I consider he is a mighty being who has slain my brothers.

sa: स्वस्ति व्रजत वो भद्रं न भेतव्यं कथंचन। नाहमार्ताब्दिाघांसामि भृशमाश्वासयामि वः॥
en: “Welcome! May you are well. Go away. You have nothing to fear. I assure you, I will not kill them who are stricken with fear."

sa: विषहेरन् महायुद्धे कृतं ते तन्महाद्भुतम्। न ते जानामि यत् कार्यं नाभिजानामि काक्षितम्॥
en: Could stand them in mighty conflict. (Therefore) what you have done is highly marvellous. Neither am I aware of what is your business nor do I know of your intentions.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्रह्मादित्यमुन्नयति देवास्तस्याभितश्चराः। धर्मश्चास्तं नयति च सत्ये च प्रतितिष्ठति॥
en: Yudhishthira said: It is Brahma that makes the sun rise. The celestials remain near him. Dharma makes him set. And he is established in truth.

sa: आज्ञा तव हि राजेन्द्र कार्या पुत्रैः सहान्वयैः। हितं बलवदप्येषां तिष्ठतां तव शासने॥
en: Your commands, O chief among kings, should be followed by your sons with their followers, and it will conduce exceedingly to their own good to act according to your orders.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च शम: स्यादिति भारत। अप्रणाशेन वीराणामेतद् याचितुमागतः॥
en: "Between the Kurus and Pandavas there may be peace, O Bharata, without the slaying of heroes (on either side) to effect this have I come.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सूर्य एको विचरते चन्द्रमा जायते पुनः। अग्निहिमस्य भैषज्यं भूमिरावपनं महत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: It is the sun that wanders alone. The moon is reborn (after her birth). Agni (fire) is the antidote to cold and the earth is the largest field.

sa: यः कश्चिदप्यसम्बद्धो मित्रभावेन वर्तते। स एव बन्धुस्तन्मित्रं सा गतिस्तत् परायणम्॥
en: That friend who, though not related in any way, yet acts as a friend; and he is a true friend, a refuge and a protector.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पाण्डवेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। प्रणम्य धर्मपुत्रं तु गतेन्द्रिय इवातुरः॥ विदीर्यमाणो व्रीडावाञ्जगाम नगरं प्रति।
en: Having been thus dismissed by the Pandavas, Duryodhana saluted the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira). Overwhelmed with shame, his heart appeared as if rent in two. He mechanically started for his city as destitute of life.

sa: अर्चयेदेव मित्राणि सति वाऽसति वा धने। नानर्थयन् प्रजानाति मित्राणां सारफल्गुताम्॥
en: Poor or rich, one should serve his friends. Unasked to do some service, a friend cannot make know the sincerity or insincerity of his heart.

sa: ततो रथेन शुभ्रेण महता किङ्किणीकिना। हयोत्तमयुजा शीघ्रमुपातिष्ठत दारुकः॥
en: Then Daruka soon came back with the large and shining car furnished with tinkling bells and yoked to excellent horses.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्यामो य एष रक्ताक्षो बृहच्छाल इवोत्थितः। व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुर्नकुलो यक्ष जीवतु॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Yaksha, let this Nakula, having dark complexion, red eyes, towering as a sala tree, endued with broad chest and long arms, be brought back to life.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच देवदेवो मया दृष्टो भवान् साक्षात् सनातनः। यं ददासि वरं तुष्टस्तं ग्रहीष्याम्यहं पितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : You are the god of gods. It is enough that I have seen you in our own shape. I will, O father, accept whatsoever boon you may be pleased to grant me.

sa: बलं बलवदप्यस्य यदि वक्ष्यसि माधव। त्वय्यस्य महती शङ्का न करिष्यति ते वचः॥
en: He has at his cominand a strong force and if you speak to him, O Madhava, he will not act according to your advice, for he entertains suspicions against you.

sa: न हास्तिनपुरे राजन्नवकाशोऽभवत् तदा॥ राज्ञां स्वबलमुख्यानां प्राधान्येनापि भारत।
en: Oking, In the city of Hastinapura, there was not space, even for the principal leaders of the king's own army.

sa: और्वेण वसता छन्नमूरौ ब्रह्मर्षिणा तदा। यत् कृतं तात देवेषु कर्म तत्तेऽनघ श्रुतम्॥
en: O Sinless one, O child you have heard of the office the regenerate Rishi Auarv at one time performed for the gods having disguised in the womb of his mother?

sa: यस्मिन् यथा वर्तते यो मनुष्यस्तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तितव्यं स धर्मः। मायाचारो मायया वर्तितव्यः साध्वाचारः साधुना, प्रत्युपेयः॥
en: It is a good policy to behave towards one in the same way he behaves towards another. One who behaves deceitfully should be served deceitfully; and one who behaves honestly should be served with honesty.

sa: तथा स तु वरॉल्लब्ध्वा धर्मो धर्मभृतां वरः। गत्वाऽऽश्रमं ब्राह्मणेभ्य आचख्यौ सर्वमेव तत्॥
en: Having thus received the boon from Dharma (the god of virtue) the best of the virtuous retired to the asylum, and described to the Brahmanas, all that came to pass.

sa: द्वादशेमानि वर्षाणि राज्यविप्रोषिता वयम्। त्रयोदशोऽयं सम्प्राप्तः कृच्छ्रात् परमदुर्वसः॥
en: For these twelve years, we have been exiled from our kingdom. This is the thirteenth year very had to pass.

sa: न च तत् कारणं विद्यो यस्मिन् नो मधुसूदन। पूजां कृतां प्रीयमाणैर्नामस्थाः पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: We do not however see any reason (for your action) in this matter, O slayer of Madhu, namely your non-acceptance of the entertainment's provided for you, O best among men.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्र महाबाहुं ददर्शासीनमासने। दुःशासनं च कर्णं च शकुनि चापि सौबलम्॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra of long arms, he saw seated on a seat and he also saw, Dushasana, Karna, Shakuni and the son of Subala.

sa: न भृत्यानां वृत्तिसंरोधनेन राज्यं धनं संजिघृक्षेदपूर्वम्। त्यजन्ति होनं वञ्चिता वै विरुद्धाः स्निग्धा ह्यमात्याः परिहीनभोगाः॥
en: Seek not to become the possessor of another's kingdom or wealth by stopping the pay of your servants. Even the affectionate ministers, defrauded and deprived of their enjoyments, turn against their master and leave him.

sa: दुःशासनस्तु भल्लेन विद्ध्वा वैराटमुत्तरम्। द्वितीयेनार्जुनं वीरः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Having pierced Virata's son Uttara with a dart, the heroic Dushasana struck Arjuna on the breast with a second one.

sa: वाक्यं तु यो नाद्रियतेऽनुशिष्टः प्रत्याह यश्चापि नियुज्यमानः। प्रज्ञाभिमानी प्रतिकूलवादी त्याज्यः स तादृक् त्वरयैक भृत्यः॥
en: The servant, who ordered pays no attention to the order and who enjoined uses arguments against the order through pride of wisdom and who speaks ill of his master, should be got rid of quickly.

sa: ग्रन्थिको नाम नाम्नाहं कमैतत् सुप्रियं मम। कुशलोऽस्म्यश्वशिक्षायां तथैवाश्वचिकित्सने।।
en: I shall be designated Granthika. The avocation is congenial to me. I am expert both in training and treating horses.

sa: प्रियाश्च सततं मेऽश्वाः कुरुराज यथा तव॥ ये मामामन्त्रयिष्यन्ति विराटनगरे जनाः। तेभ्य एवं प्रवक्ष्यामि विहरिष्याम्यहं यथा॥ पाण्डवेन पुरा तात अश्वेष्वधिकृतः : पुरा। विराटनगरे छन्नश्चरिष्यामि महीपते॥
en: O king of the Kurus, horses are even dear to me as they are to you. Those who will question me in the city of the Virat will be thus told by me. "Formerly I was placed by Yudhishthira in charge of his horses. O ruler of the earth, I shall thus disguised go about in the city of Virata.

sa: नैव शक्याः पराजेतुं सर्वं ह्येषां तथाविधम्। पितरं त्वेव गर्हेयं नात्मानं न सुयोधनम्॥
en: All of them having such like qualities are incapable of being defeated by the enemies. But my father is to blame ((for all this grief) and not myself, nor Suyodhana.

sa: तत्रैव धृतराष्ट्रश्च महाराजश्च बाह्निकः। कृपश्च सोमदत्तश्च निर्विण्णाः कुरवस्तथा॥
en: There were at the time Dhritarashtra, the great king Balhika, Kripa, Somadatta and the Kurus who were pained at it.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वः शूराणां मया संख्ये समागमः। पदापातेन महता शङ्खानां निस्वनेन च॥
en: I had never seen before in battle such an assemblage of heroes. By the great sound of the clashing of maces, the blare of conchs

sa: सा दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमायान्तं प्रसन्नादित्यवर्चसम्। कण्ठे गृहीत्वा प्राक्रोशत् स्मरन्ती तनयान् पृथा॥
en: Seeing Krishna approaching and effulgent like the radiant sun, Pritha clasped his neck with her arms and poured forth her loud lamentations, remembering her sons.

sa: कान्तारेष्ववसन्नानां मग्नानां च महार्णवे॥ दस्युभिर्वा निरुद्धानां त्वं गतिः परमा नृणाम्।
en: You are the greatest refuge of people who are groping in the wilderness, getting drowned in the great ocean, and are taken captives by high-way-men.

sa: चलेद्धि हिमवाञ्छैलो मेदिनी शतधा फलेत्। द्यौः पतेच्च सनक्षत्रान मे मोघं वचो भवेत्॥
en: The Himavat mountains could move; the earth could be split up into a hundred pieces; and the heavenly regions with stars might fall; but my words would not be vain.

sa: शक्ष्यन्ति हि महाबाहो पाण्डवाः संजयैः सह। धार्तराष्ट्रबलं घोरं क्रुद्ध प्रतिसमासितुम्॥
en: O you of long arms, the Pandavas supported by the Srinjayas will be able to fight with the terrible army of Dhritarashtra excited with range.

sa: शरास्तयोस्तु विबभुः कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः। पङ्क्त्यः शरदि खस्थानां हंसानां चरतामिव॥
en: Decked with the feathers of Kanka birds, these arrows looked like a number of cranes wandering in the autumnal sky.

sa: सर्वथा तु मया कार्यं धर्मराजस्य शासनम्। विभाव्यं तस्य भूयश्च कर्म पापं दुरात्मनः॥
en: The instructions of the king of virtue will always be attended to by me; and the wicked acts of that evil-souled one will have again to be considered by me.

sa: विससर्ज शरांश्चित्रान् सुवर्णविकृतान् बहून्। नाशयन् शरवर्षाणि भारद्वाजस्य वीर्यवान्।
en: Shot a number of variegated golden arrows; and that energetic (hero) baffled the downpour of shafts made by Bharadvaja's son.

sa: उषिताः स्मो वने वासं प्रतिकर्म चिकीर्षवः। कोपं नार्हसि नः कर्तुं सदा समरदुर्जय॥
en: Having spent out the term of our exile in the woods, we wish to take revenge. O you irrepressible in battle, it does not behove you to be always angry.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा हता सूतपुत्रेण राजपत्नी यशस्विनी। वधं कृष्णा परीप्सन्ती सेनावाहस्य भामिनी।।।।
en: Vaishampayana said Thus outraged by the Suta's son that illustrious princess Krishna of exceeding beauty, brooding over the destruction of the leader of Virata's forces, repaired to her own apartments.

sa: अहो युद्धाभिकाङ्क्षाणां युद्धकाल उपस्थिते। चेतांसि विप्रतीपानि यत् त्वां भीर्भीम विन्दति॥
en: Alas! at the approach of the time for fight the hearts of those who are inclined towards will be swerved away; since fear penetrates you.

sa: यस्य नास्ति समो वीर्ये कश्चिदुर्व्या धनुर्धरः। सोऽद्य कन्यापरिवृतो गायन्नास्ते धनंजयः॥
en: That Dhananjaya, to whom there is no bowman on the entire earth, equal in prowess, is now passing his days in singing surrounded by women.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धनंजयवचः श्रुत्वा वैराटिस्त्वरितस्ततः। हयान् रजतसंकाशान् हेमभाण्डानचोदयत्॥
en: Hearing the words of Arjuna, Virata's son, without loss of time, urged his silver white steeds decked in golden armour.

sa: सर्वदेवनिकायाच सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अर्जुनस्य कुरूणां च द्रष्टुं युद्धमुपागताः॥
en: All the deities, the Siddhas and the great Rishis came there to witness the fight between Arjuna and the Kurus.

sa: नारायणी चेन्द्रसेना रूपेण यदि ते श्रुता। पतिमन्वचरद् वृद्धं पुरा वर्षसहस्रिणम्॥
en: In olden days, perhaps you may have heard that Indrasena, who resembled Narayani in beauty, followed her old husband or a thousand years of age.

sa: अभ्याशे वाजिनस्तस्थुः समारूढाः प्रहारिणः। भीमरूपाश्च मातङ्गास्तोमराङ्कुशनोदिताः। महामात्रैः समारूढा विचित्रकवचोज्ज्वलाः॥ ततः शक्रः सुरगणैः समारुह्य सुदर्शनम्। सहोपायात् तदा राजन् विश्वाश्चिमरुतां गणैः॥ तद् देवयक्षगन्धर्वमहोरगसमाकुलम्। शुशुभेऽभ्रविनिर्मुक्तं ग्रहाणामिव मण्डलम्॥ अस्त्राणां च बलं तेषां मानुषेषु प्रयुञ्जताम्। तच्च भीमं महद् युद्धं कृपार्जुनसमागमे। द्रष्टुमभ्यागता देवाः स्वविमानैः पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: And near them stood the enemy's cavalry managed by warriors. There were also terrible looking elephants bedecked with beautiful armours governed by clever heroes and urged by Tomaras and gaudas. There came on a beautiful car Shakra accompanied by the celestials, Vishvas and Maruts, O king. Filled with the celestials, Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Nagas the sky looked resplendent as it does when freed from cloud sand crested with stars. The celestials came there in their respective cars to witness the efficacy of their weapons in a human battle as well as the dreadful and great fight between Kripa and Arjuna.

sa: अक्षौहिणी तु सा सेना तदा यौधिष्ठिरं बलम्। प्रविश्यान्तर्दधे राजन् सागरं कुनदी यथा॥
en: And that army, numbering an Akshauhini when it became incorporated with Yudhishthira's army, vanished as it were, O king, as does a small river when it falls into the sea.

sa: द्रुमाद् रुक्मी महातेजा विजयं प्रत्यपद्यत। संछिद्य मौरवान् पाशान् निहत्य मुरमोजसा॥
en: Rukmi of great energy, obtained the Vijaya from Druma after breaking open the knots and nooses of Mura and slaying Asura by his own energy.

sa: ध्वजे कमण्डलुर्यस्य शातकौम्भमयः शुभः। आचार्य एष हि द्रोण: सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: That hero, on whose flag is the emblem of a beautiful golden water pot, is the preceptor Drona-the foremost of the wielders of all weapons.

sa: प्रार्थयन्ति सुकेशान्ते ये त्वां शीलगुणान्विताम्। एवं ते भीरु वध्यन्ते कीचकः शोभते यथा॥
en: "O you of fair hair, O timid damsel, all those who seek you who are gifted with a good character and accomplishments, will be slain by me like this Kichaka."

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच चक्षुष्मतां वै स्पृहयामि संजय द्रक्ष्यन्ति ये वासुदेव समीपे। विभ्राजमानं वपुषा परेण प्रकाशयन्तं प्रदिशो दिशश्च।।।।
en: Dhritarashtra said I envy those who have eyes, O Sanjaya and who will see before them the son of Vasudeva with his body shining with great lustre in the cardinal points of the earth and in the points between them.

sa: सुदेष्णामब्रवीद् राजा महिषीं जातसाध्वसः। सैरन्ध्रीमागतां ब्रूया ममैव वचनादिदम्॥
en: Then filled with fear, the king said to his queen Sudeshna: 'When Sairandhri comes, tell her these words of mine.

sa: दमस्तेजो वर्धयति पवित्रं दम उत्तमम्। विपाप्मा वृद्धतेजास्तु पुरुषो विन्दते महत्॥
en: Self-control increases energy; self-control is excellent and holy. Absolved from his sins and having his energy increased (by selfcontrol) a man obtains great results. are

sa: तथैव गत्वा बीभत्सुर्नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः। शलभैरिव तां सेनां शरैः शीघ्रमवाकिरत्॥
en: (In the mean time) going there ard announcing himself as Bibhatsu by name he speedily covered the soldiers with shafts like a swarm of locusts.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच सदृशानां मनुष्येषु सर्वेषां तुल्यजन्मनाम्। कथमेकान्ततस्तेषां पार्थानां मन्यसे जयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Why do you consider victory to be the sole monopoly of the sons of Pritha who are similar to those of all men.

sa: यद् वा परमकं तेजो येन युक्ता दिवौकसः। ममाप्यनुपमं भूयो देवेभ्यो विद्धि भारत॥
en: The divine energy with which the denizens of haven endued is great; but mine, too, is without parallel and so greater than that of the gods; know this, O Bharata.

sa: इत्येवं चिन्तयत् कृत्स्नमहोरात्राणि भारत। अनिद्रो निःसुखश्चास्मि कुरूणां शमचिन्तया॥
en: Thinking this day and night, O Bharata, am I sleepless and unhappy through anxiety for the good of the Kurus.

sa: तस्माद् यत्नात् प्रतीक्षन्ते कालस्योदयमागतम्। न हि ते नाशमृच्छेयुरिति पश्याम्यहं धिया॥
en: It is for this they are carefully waiting for the opportune hour. Such persons never die; this is what I perceive by my good sense.

sa: प्रसंख्याय च सौक्ष्म्येण गुणदोषान् विचक्षणः। यथावन्मतितत्त्वेन जयकामः सुतान् प्रति॥ बलाबलं विनिश्चित्य याथातथ्येन बुद्धिमान्। शक्ति संख्यातुमारेभे तदा वै मनुजाधिपः॥
en: Having skillfully counted the merits and defeats as far as in his power that wise and intelligent king of men, desirous of victory for his sons and having ascertained the strength and weakness of both parties by suitable means, commanded counting the army of each.

sa: केशवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा किरीटी श्वेतवाहनः। अर्जुनस्तन्महद् वाक्यमब्रवीद् रोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Having heard the words of Keshava, Kiritin of white steeds, Arjuna spoke significant words calculated to make the hairs erect.

sa: तेजोमयं दुराधर्षं गाण्डीवं यस्य कार्मुकम्। मद्वितीयेन तेनेह वैरं वः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Him whose weapon is the invisible Gandiva bow, full of energy and him who has me for his second-of such Savyasachin have you made enemy.

sa: तस्माद् बलं च कोषश्च नीतिश्चापि विधीयताम्। यथा कालोदये प्राप्ते सम्यक् तैः संदधामहे॥
en: Therefore (replenish) your treasury and (increase) your forces; and take recourse to a sound policy to conclude an advantageous treaty with them, when the proper time of their return comes.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सर्वान् वस्तात शोचामि त्यक्तो दुर्योधनो मया। ये मन्दमनुयास्यध्वं यान्तं वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said I grieve for you all, O rulers, who are following that fool to the abode of the king of death; but Duryodhana is cast off by me forever.

sa: मप्रियं पार्थिवाः सर्वे ये चिकीर्षन्ति भारत। ते तानावारयिष्यन्ति ऐणेयानिव तन्तुना॥
en: Those rulers of the earth, who wish me well, O Bharata, will get hold of them, as deer are caught by means of a trap.

sa: सहदेवस्तु माद्रेयः शूरः संक्रन्दनो युधि। स्वमंशं कल्पयामास श्यालं ते सुबलात्मजम्॥
en: The son of Madri, the hero Sahadeva, who makes loud roars in battle, has accepted as his own share your brother the son of Subala.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कांस्तत्र संजयापश्यः प्रीत्यर्थेन समागतान्। ये योत्स्यन्ते पाण्डवार्थं पुत्रस्य मम वाहिनीम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Whom have you, O Sanjaya, seen there coming out of love and who will fight with the army of my sons on behalf of the sons of Pandu?

sa: अनेन वीर्येण कथं गास्त्वं प्रार्थयसे बलात्। कथं चानुचरांस्त्यक्त्वा शत्रुमध्ये विषीदसि॥
en: With such powers how could you think of taking away the kine? Why forsaking your followers do you droop in the midst of your enemies?

sa: अवजित्य सुशर्माणं धनं चादाय सर्वशः॥ स्वबाहुबलसम्पन्ना ह्रीनिषेवा यतव्रताः।
en: Discomfitting Susharma and taking all his wealth-they, endued with the strength of their own arms, humble and observant of vows,

sa: मन्युस्तस्य कथं शाम्येन्मन्दान् प्रति य उत्थितः। अन्येऽप्यस्त्राणि जानन्ति जीयन्ते च जयन्ति च॥
en: How can his wrath that has arisen, against those foolish ones be pacified; there are others knowing the use of weapons, who conquer (others) and (sometimes) are conquered (by those).

sa: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य कर्माणि विहितानि स्वयम्भुवा। धनं यैरधिगन्तव्यं यच्च कुर्वन् न दुष्यति॥
en: The actions of the four orders have been ordained by the Self Sprung (Brahma) so that they may acquire wealth without committing a sinful act.

sa: सुदक्षिणश्च काम्बोजो यवनैश्च शकैस्तथा॥ उपाजगाम कौरव्यमक्षौहिण्या विशाम्पते। तस्य सेनासमावायः शलभानामिवाबभौ॥ स च सम्प्राप्य कौरव्यं तत्रैवान्तर्दधे तदा।
en: Oking! Sudakshina, the ruler of Kamboja with the Yavanas and the Shakas came to the son of Kuru, with an Akshauhini of troops. His army looked beautiful like locusts. And having entered the Kaurava army it vanished at the time.

sa: महेन्द्र इव वज्रेण दानवान् देवसत्तमः। भीमसेनो गदापाणिः सूदयिष्यति मे सुतान्॥
en: Like that chief among the gods, great Indra with his thunderbolt (killing) the Danavas, Bhimasena with mace in his hand will kill my a sons.

sa: नाचिरं निहतस्तस्य संग्रामे रथसारथिः। तेन नास्ति समः सूतो योऽस्य सारथ्यमाचरेत्॥
en: Very recently the charioteer of his car was slain in battle; there is none equal to him who can act as his (my brother's) charioteer.

sa: अथैतद् वचनं मेऽद्य नियुक्ता न करिष्यसि। प्रणयादुच्यमाना त्वं परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: I, who have asked you for this, shall give up my life. Being thus accosted by his friend of fair hips, that slayer of foes,

sa: अर्जुनस्य किलासीस्त्वं सारथिर्दयित: पुरा। त्वयाजयत् सहायेन पृथिवीं पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: By your help, that foremost of the Pandavas conquered the world. Brihannala replied to the prince who had said this.

sa: एवंरूपो महात्मा स पावकं पुरुषो गिरन्। यो वै तं पुरुषं वेद तस्येहार्थो न रिष्यते। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: Of this description is that illustrious Being in whom is lost all living creatures. He who knows that sacred being does not envy the attainment of objects of others in this world, (he himself having attained to emancipation). Ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: सोऽपसव्यां चमूं तस्य शाल्वस्य भरतर्षभ। चकार नातियत्नेन तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: O foremost of men, he wheeled round Shalva's army so easily that they who witnessed it became very much surprised.

sa: तत्र वेदेषु नष्टेषु मुनेरङ्गिरसः सुतः। ऋषीणामुत्तरीयेषु सूपविष्टो यथासुखम्॥
en: There when the Vedas were lost, the son of Rishi Angirasa, sitting comfortably on the upper garments of the Rishis.

sa: किं त्वस्य सुकृतं कर्म के लोका वै विनिर्जिताः। स एवमनुसम्प्राप्तः स्थानं देवनमस्कृतम्॥
en: What act of merit had been performed by him and what regions had been conquered by him that he had obtained a seat which was worshipped by the celestials themselves?

sa: कृपश्च सोमदत्तश्च बाह्रीकश्च महामनाः॥ ततोऽहमब्रुवं तत्र विदुरेण प्रचोदितः।
en: Kripa, Somadatta, and the high souled Valhika. It was then at the advice of Vidura, I spoke thus (to Draupadi).

sa: पारिबर्ह च तं शेषं परिदाय महात्मने। ततस्ते यज्ञपात्राणि रत्नान्याभरणानि च।॥ न्यदधुः पाण्डवा राजन्नाश्रमे वृषपर्वणः। अतीतानागते विद्वान् कुशलः सर्वधर्मवित्॥
en: And having also committed to his charge their remaining clothes, O king, the sons of Pandu left their sacred ornaments and sacrificial vessels in the hermitage of Vrishaparva. That (sage) well learned, versed in all religions, having a knowledge of the past and the future,

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), Let us cry "success!"

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्तमासाद्य सर्पभोगेन वेष्टितम्। दयितं भ्रातरधीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The intellectual Yudhishthira, beholding his dear brother coiled by the body of the snake addressed him thus.

sa: ततः फल्गुं व्रजेद् राजस्तीर्थसेवी नराधिय। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सिद्धिं च महतीं व्रजेत्॥
en: O king, O ruler of men, the pilgrim should then go to Falgu; he obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and attains to great success.

sa: ते कीर्यमाणाः खगमाः शरवर्षेः समन्ततः। न शेकुः पाण्डुपुत्राणां समीपे परिवर्तितुम्॥
en: Those mighty rangers of the sky, thus checked on all sides by that shower of arrows, did not succeed to come even near the Pandavas.

sa: उच्छिष्टं तु यवक्रीतमपकृष्टकमण्डलुम्। तत उद्यतशूलः स राक्षसः समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: The Rakshasha with uplifted spear rushed upon Yavakrit who was robbed of his waterpot and who had thus become unclean.

sa: आर्याञ्छोलवतो दृष्ट्वा ह्रीमतो वृत्तिकर्शितान्। अनार्यान् सुखिनश्चैव विह्वलामीव चिन्तया।॥
en: Sceing elderly, well behaved and modest persons, in distress and the vicious, in happiness, I am beside myself with thought.

sa: व्यसनं वास्य काक्षेत विवासं वा युधिष्ठिर। अपि सिन्धोगिरेर्वापि किं पुनर्मर्त्यधर्मिणः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, he should wish for the calamity and banishment (of his foe), what of mortal men, even he be an ocean or a mountain.

sa: रामतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोमत्यां कुरुनन्दन॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति पुनाति च कुलं नरः।
en: O descendant of Kuru, bathing in the Rama Tirtha in the Gomati, a man, obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and sanctifies his own race.

sa: गङ्गोद्भेदं समासाद्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मभूतो भवेत् सदा॥
en: Going to Gangodbheda and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains fruits of Vajapeya and becomes like Brahma himself.

sa: नाटकेयांश्च समरे तथा हेरम्बकान् युधि॥ मारुधं च विनिर्जित्य रम्यग्राममथो बलात्। नाचीनानर्धकांश्चैव राज्ञश्चैव महाबलः॥ तांस्तानाटविकीन् सर्वानजयत् पाण्डुनन्दनः। वाताधिपं च नृपति वशं चक्रे महाबलः॥
en: Having then defeated in battle the Natakeyas and the Herambakas, and having subjugated the Marudhas, he conquered Munjagrama by force. He then vanquished the kings of the Nachinas, the Arbukas and the various other forest kings who ruled in that part of the country. The greatly powerful son of Pandu then subjugated the king Vatadhipa.

sa: तांस्तथा व्यथितान् दीनान् भिक्षमाणान् युधिष्ठिरम्। वृद्धान् दुर्योधनामात्यान् भीमसेनोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Then to those old counsellors of Duryodhana who came, in grief and being melancholy, ask protection from Yudhishthira, Bhimsena said,

sa: तत् पुण्यं परमं ब्रह्म तत् तीर्थं तत् तपोवनम्। तत् परं परमं देवं भूतानां परमेश्वरम्॥
en: He is virtue, he is the supreme Brahma, he is the Tirtha, he is the ascetic retreat, he is the first, he is the foremost of gods, he is the great lord of all creatures.

sa: धातैव खलु भूतानां सुखदुःखे प्रियाप्रिये। दधाति सर्वमीशानः पुरस्ताच्छुक्रमुच्चरन्॥
en: The Lord Ishana ordains beforehand, with reference to weal and woe, happiness and misery, of all creatures like a seed.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच याज्ञसेन्या वचः श्रुत्वा भीमसेनो झमर्षणः। निःश्वसन्नुपसंगम्य क्रुद्धो राजानमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of Yajnaseni (Draupadi), Bhimasena came to the king (Yudhishthira). And sighing in wrath, he thus spoke to him.

sa: एवं कृतास्त्रः कौन्तेयो गान्धर्वं वेदमाप्तवान्। सुखं वसति बीभत्सुरनुजस्यानुजस्तव॥
en: Having thus acquired all weapons and learnt the Gandharva Veda (knowledge) your third brother Vivatsu (Arjuna) lives happily in (heaven).

sa: एतदात्मवतां वृत्तमेषधर्मः सनातनः। क्षमा चैवानृशंस्यं च तत् कर्तास्म्यहमञ्जसा॥
en: Forgiveness and humility are the qualities of the self-controlled and constitute the eternal virtue and I shall therefore adopt them.

sa: सिंहनादेन महता योधानां गर्जितेन च। रथनेमिनिनादैश्च कम्पयन् वसुधामिमाम्॥
en: The earth trembled with the shouts and the leonine roars of the warriors and the rattle of the chariot wheels.

sa: दुर्मनुष्या हि निर्वेदमफलं स्वार्थघातकम्। अशक्ताः श्रियमाहर्तुमात्मनः कुर्वते प्रियम्॥
en: Cowards only, being unable to win back their prosperity, cherish despair which is fruitless and destructive of one's own purpose.

sa: ततः स गुर्वी यमदण्डकल्पां महागदां काञ्चनपट्टनद्धाम्। प्रगृह्य तानभ्यपतत् तरस्वी ततोऽब्रवीत् तिष्ठत तिष्ठतेति॥
en: Thereupon that greatly powerful hero, taking up his huge and mighty mace inlaid with gold which resembled the mace of Yama himself, turned towards those (Rakshasas) and exclaimed, "Stay," "Stay".

sa: एतदेवंविधं चित्रमिह तात युधिष्ठिर। प्रेक्षन्ते सर्वभूतानि बहुशः पर्वसंधिषु॥
en: O affectionate one, O Yudhishthira, all souls in the Gandhamadana, observe these and similar wonders several times during the Parvas.

sa: भुञ्जाना मुनिभोज्यानि रसवन्ति फलानि च। वसध्वं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठा यावदर्जुनदर्शनात्॥
en: O best of the Pandavas, remain here living on luscious fruits eaten by the sages, until you meet with Arjuna.

sa: अन्यायेनेह यः कश्चिदवमान्यधनेश्वरम्। विहर्तुमिच्छेद् दुर्वृत्तः स विनश्येन्न संशयः॥
en: That wicked person, who without heeding the lord of wealth (Kubera), unlawfully tries to sport here, certainly meets with destruction.

sa: ममापि हि महान् हर्षो यदहं भीमफाल्गुनौ। क्लिष्टावरण्ये पश्येयं कृष्णया सहिताविति।॥
en: I shall certainly feel great delight if I see Bhima and Falguna (Arjuna) passing their days with Krishna (Draupadi) in great misery in the forest.

sa: परिदेवति तान् वीरान् धृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः। मन्यतेऽभ्यधिकांश्चापि तपोयोगेन पाण्डवान्॥
en: King Dhritarashtra is always grieving for those heroes. The king considers them (now) more powerful (than before) by their asceticism.

sa: तद्वाक्यसमकालं च कृतं सर्वं न्यवेदयत्। सहदेवो युधां श्रेष्ठो धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: As soon as these words were uttered by Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, that foremost of all warriors, Sahadeva, informed the king that they had been all done.

sa: प्राच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च प्रतीच्योदीच्यवासिनः। कृताः करप्रदाः सर्वे राजानस्ते नराधिप।॥
en: O ruler of men, O king, the kings of the east, west, north and south all pay tribute to you.

sa: ततो द्वैपायनो राजन्नृत्विजः समुपानयत्। वेदान्व महाभागान् साक्षान्मूर्तिमतो द्विजान्॥
en: O king, Dvaipayana then appointed the Ritvijas, who were high-souled, and who were like the Vedas in their personified forms.

sa: प्रतरेच्च कुलं पुण्यं सर्वपापं व्यपोहति। गोसहस्रफलं लब्ध्वा पुनाति स्वकुलं नरः॥
en: Sanctifying his own race, he is cleansed of all his sins. Receiving the fruits of giving away one thousand kine, a man sanctifies his race.

sa: तत्र वै दक्षिणाकाले ब्रह्मघोषो दिवं गतः। न च प्रज्ञायते किंचिद् ब्रह्मशब्देन भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when the time for distributing Dakshina (gift) came, the chanting of the Vedas reached heaven. Nothing else could be heard for that chanting of the Vedas.

sa: गयस्य यज्ञे के त्वद्य प्राणिनो भोक्तुमीप्सवः। तत्र भोजनशिष्टस्य पर्वताः पञ्चविंशतिः॥
en: “Who is there among creatures that desires to day to eat more in the sacrifice of Gaya? There are still twenty-five mountains of food (uneaten).
